## Step 1.5: Diagnose Current Results and Assess Model Fit

```{r diagnose-results}
cat("=== DIAGNOSING MONTE CARLO RESULTS ===\n")

# Check structure of results
if(length(monte_carlo_results$parameters) > 0) {
  cat("Parameters structure - first result fields:\n")
  cat(paste(names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]]), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Monte Carlo Results Summary:\n")
  cat("  Total simulations attempted:", monte_carlo_results$n_attempts, "\n")
  cat("  Successful simulations:", monte_carlo_results$n_successful, "\n")
  cat("  Success rate:", round(monte_carlo_results$n_successful/monte_carlo_results$n_attempts*100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("  Failed simulations:", length(monte_carlo_results$failed), "\n\n")
  
  # Check gamma parameter variability
  if("gamma_change" %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {
    all_gamma_changes <- unlist(lapply(monte_carlo_results$parameters, function(x) x$gamma_change))
    cat("Gamma parameter analysis:\n")
    cat("  Range:", round(min(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "to", round(max(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
    cat("  Mean:", round(mean(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "± SD:", round(sd(all_gamma_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("  Example values:", paste(round(all_gamma_changes[seq_len(min(10, length(all_gamma_changes)))], 3), collapse=", "), "\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("WARNING: gamma_change not found in parameters!\n\n")
  }
  
  # Check catchability parameter variability
  if("catchability_change" %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {
    all_catch_changes <- unlist(lapply(monte_carlo_results$parameters, function(x) {
      if(length(x$catchability_change) > 0) x$catchability_change else NA
    }))
    all_catch_changes <- all_catch_changes[!is.na(all_catch_changes)]
    
    if(length(all_catch_changes) > 0) {
      cat("Catchability parameter analysis:\n")
      cat("  Range:", round(min(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "to", round(max(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Mean:", round(mean(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "± SD:", round(sd(all_catch_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("No catchability variations found\n\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Check abundance scaling variability
  if("abundance_scaling" %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {
    all_abund_changes <- unlist(lapply(monte_carlo_results$parameters, function(x) x$abundance_scaling))
    cat("Abundance scaling analysis:\n")
    cat("  Range:", round(min(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "to", round(max(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
    cat("  Mean:", round(mean(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "± SD:", round(sd(all_abund_changes, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n\n")
  }
  
  # Check if simulations are valid mizer objects
  sims_valid <- sum(sapply(monte_carlo_results$simulations, function(x) {
    !is.null(x) && inherits(x, "MizerSim")
  }))
  cat("Valid mizer simulation objects:", sims_valid, "\n")
  
  # Basic model fit assessment using yield data
  if(sims_valid > 0 && exists("yield_ts_tidy")) {
    cat("\n=== MODEL FIT ASSESSMENT ===\n")
    
    # Calculate fit metrics for available simulations
    fit_metrics <- data.frame()
    
    for(i in seq_along(monte_carlo_results$simulations)) {
      sim <- monte_carlo_results$simulations[[i]]
      if(!is.null(sim) && inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) {
        
        tryCatch({
          # Extract modeled yields using mizer functions
          yield_matrix <- getYield(sim)
          yield_df <- reshape2::melt(yield_matrix)
          names(yield_df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
          
          # Filter for comparison period across the full observed range
          obs_years <- range(yield_ts_tidy$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
          model_yield_period <- yield_df %>%
            filter(Year >= obs_years[1], Year <= obs_years[2])
          
          if(nrow(model_yield_period) > 0) {
            # Calculate total yield over period
            model_total <- sum(model_yield_period$Yield, na.rm=TRUE)
            
            # Compare with observed data if available
            if(exists("yield_ts_tidy") && !is.null(yield_ts_tidy)) {
              obs_period <- yield_ts_tidy
              
              if(nrow(obs_period) > 0) {
                obs_total <- sum(obs_period$Yield, na.rm=TRUE)
                
                # Calculate annual correlation if possible
                annual_comparison <- model_yield_period %>%
                  group_by(Year) %>%
                  summarise(model_yield = sum(Yield, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
                  left_join(obs_period %>% 
                           group_by(Year) %>%
                           summarise(obs_yield = sum(Yield, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = 'drop'),
                           by = "Year") %>%
                  filter(!is.na(obs_yield), !is.na(model_yield))
                
                if(nrow(annual_comparison) > 5) {
                  correlation <- cor(annual_comparison$model_yield, annual_comparison$obs_yield, use="complete.obs")
                  rmse <- sqrt(mean((annual_comparison$model_yield - annual_comparison$obs_yield)^2, na.rm=TRUE))
                  normalized_rmse <- rmse / mean(annual_comparison$obs_yield, na.rm=TRUE)
                  
                  fit_metrics <- rbind(fit_metrics, data.frame(
                    sim_id = i,
                    correlation = correlation,
                    rmse = rmse,
                    normalized_rmse = normalized_rmse,
                    model_total = model_total,
                    observed_total = obs_total
                  ))
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          # Skip simulations that can't be processed
          cat("  Simulation", i, "failed yield extraction:", e$message, "\n")
        })
      }
    }
    
    if(nrow(fit_metrics) > 0) {
      cat("Model fit summary (", nrow(fit_metrics), " simulations):\n")
      cat("  Correlation range:", round(min(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "to", round(max(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Mean correlation:", round(mean(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "± SD:", round(sd(fit_metrics$correlation, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Normalized RMSE range:", round(min(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "to", round(max(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("  Mean normalized RMSE:", round(mean(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), 
          "± SD:", round(sd(fit_metrics$normalized_rmse, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n\n")
      
      # Show best fitting simulations
      best_sims <- fit_metrics[order(-fit_metrics$correlation, fit_metrics$normalized_rmse), ]
      cat("Top 3 fitting simulations:\n")
  for(j in seq_len(min(3, nrow(best_sims)))) {
        cat("  Sim", best_sims$sim_id[j], ": r =", round(best_sims$correlation[j], 3), 
            ", NRMSE =", round(best_sims$normalized_rmse[j], 3), "\n")
      }
      
    } else {
      cat("No valid yield comparisons with observed data available\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No valid simulations available for model fit assessment\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No parameter combinations found!\n")
}

# Parameter space refinement suggestions
cat("\n=== PARAMETER SPACE REFINEMENT SUGGESTIONS ===\n")

if(exists("fit_metrics") && nrow(fit_metrics) > 0) {
  # Analyze parameter combinations of best-performing simulations
  cat("Based on model fit analysis:\n")
  
  best_sim_ids <- {
    ord <- order(-fit_metrics$correlation, fit_metrics$normalized_rmse)
    fit_metrics$sim_id[ord][seq_len(min(3, length(ord)))]
  }
  
  for(param_type in c("gamma_change", "catchability_change", "abundance_scaling")) {
    if(param_type %in% names(monte_carlo_results$parameters[[1]])) {

        params <- monte_carlo_results$parameters[[id]]
        if(param_type %in% names(params) && length(params[[param_type]]) > 0) {
          mean(params[[param_type]], na.rm=TRUE)
        } else {
          NA
        }
      })
      
      if(any(!is.na(best_values))) {
        cat("  Best", gsub("_change|_scaling", "", param_type), "factors:", 
            paste(round(best_values[!is.na(best_values)], 3), collapse=", "), "\n")
        cat("    -> Suggests focusing search around", 
            round(mean(best_values, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "± ", 
            round(sd(best_values, na.rm=TRUE), 2), "\n")
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for parameter refinement suggestions.\n")
  cat("Recommendations:\n")
  cat("  1. Check if SD values are too extreme - consider reducing to SD=1-2\n")
  cat("  2. Verify steady-state convergence criteria aren't too strict\n")
  cat("  3. Consider increasing simulation time or relaxing tolerance\n")
  cat("  4. Increase number of simulations to improve success rate\n")
  cat("  5. Check if biomass rejection criteria are appropriate\n")
}
```

## Step 2: Assess Parameter Distributions (Pre-Rejection)

Before applying any rejection criteria, let's examine the distributions of the parameters we varied.

```{r assess-parameter-distributions}
cat("=== PARAMETER DISTRIBUTION ASSESSMENT ===\n")

# Improved gamma plotter: bin in log10 space with readable ticks and robust limits
plot_gamma_distribution_fixed <- function(param_combinations, title_suffix = "") {
  require(ggplot2)
  require(dplyr)
  require(scales)

  gamma_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_combinations), function(i) {
    params <- param_combinations[[i]]
    if (is.null(params)) return(NULL)
    # Prefer the raw multiplier (pre-clamp) if present; fallback to effective change vs original
    val <- if (!is.null(params$gamma_change_raw)) params$gamma_change_raw else params$gamma_change
    if (is.null(val)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      sim_id = i,
      species = params$species_names,
      gamma_change = val
    )
  }))

  if (is.null(gamma_data) || nrow(gamma_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle = "No data"))
  }

  # Keep finite, positive values and switch to log10 for proper histogram binning
  gamma_data <- gamma_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$gamma_change), .data$gamma_change > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(log10_gamma = log10(.data$gamma_change))

  if (nrow(gamma_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + labs(title = paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle = "No positive finite values"))
  }

  # Robust limits: trim extreme tails to focus on the mass
  rng <- quantile(gamma_data$log10_gamma, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    rng <- range(gamma_data$log10_gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  pad <- max(0.05, (rng[2] - rng[1]) * 0.05)
  xmin <- floor(rng[1] - pad)
  xmax <- ceiling(rng[2] + pad)

  # Binwidth ~ 0.1 decade (adjust to spread bins sensibly)
  bw <- max(0.05, (xmax - xmin) / 60)
  breaks <- seq(floor(xmin), ceiling(xmax))

  ggplot(gamma_data, aes(x = log10_gamma)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = bw, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = breaks,
      labels = function(x) scales::math_format(10^.x)(x)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xmin, xmax)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix),
      x = "Gamma Change Factor (log10 scale)",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.8)
}

# Build priors from a previous Monte Carlo results RDS
compute_priors_from_results <- function(rds_path,
                                        accepted_only = TRUE,
                                        species_reference) {
  res <- readRDS(rds_path)
  # Detect parameter list
  param_list <- NULL
  if (!is.null(res$accepted_parameters) && accepted_only) {
    param_list <- res$accepted_parameters
  } else if (!is.null(res$parameters)) {
    param_list <- res$parameters
  } else {
    stop("Could not find parameter combinations in provided RDS")
  }

  # Extract per-sim parameter changes
  df_list <- lapply(param_list, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    sp <- x$species_names
    # Prefer raw multiplier when available
    gamma_mult <- if (!is.null(x$gamma_change_raw)) x$gamma_change_raw else x$gamma_change
    abund_mult <- x$abundance_scaling
    if (is.null(sp) || is.null(gamma_mult) || is.null(abund_mult)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(species = sp, gamma_mult = gamma_mult, abundance_mult = abund_mult)
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) stop("No usable parameter data in prior RDS")

  # Aggregate to medians per species
  med <- df %>% dplyr::group_by(species) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      gamma_prior = median(gamma_mult, na.rm = TRUE),
      abundance_prior = median(abundance_mult, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  # Align to reference species order; default 1 if missing
  ref <- species_reference
  gpr <- setNames(rep(1, length(ref)), ref)
  apr <- setNames(rep(1, length(ref)), ref)
  common <- intersect(ref, med$species)
  if (length(common) > 0) {
    msub <- med[match(common, med$species), ]
    gpr[common] <- msub$gamma_prior
    apr[common] <- msub$abundance_prior
  }
  list(gamma_prior = gpr, abundance_prior = apr)
}

# Plot gamma parameter distributions (log-binned for interpretability)
```

## Step 3: Apply Biomass-Based Rejection Criteria

Now we apply the strict rejection criteria: remove any parameter sets where the modeled biomass 
(averaged over 2000-2010) falls outside ±25% of the observed biomass (2010-2020) for ANY species.

```{r define-relaxed-rejection, echo=FALSE}
# Relaxed biomass rejection criteria allowing up to N species outside bounds
apply_biomass_rejection_criteria <- function(sim_results, param_combinations,
                                             obs_biomass_data,
                                             tolerance = 0.25,
                                             comparison_years = 2000:2010,
                                             verbose = TRUE,
                                             allow_outside = 3,
                                             obs_bounds_table = NULL) {
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Applying biomass rejection criteria ... (allow up to", allow_outside, "species outside bounds)\n")
  }

  # Determine observed bounds per species
  if (!is.null(obs_bounds_table)) {
    # Use provided species-specific bounds (in grams)
    obs_bounds <- obs_bounds_table %>%
      dplyr::transmute(Species, lower_bound = Lower_g, upper_bound = Upper_g)
  } else if (exists("obs_biomass_bounds")) {
    # Use globally defined species-specific bounds (in grams)
    obs_bounds <- obs_biomass_bounds %>%
      dplyr::transmute(Species, lower_bound = Lower_g, upper_bound = Upper_g)
  } else {
    # Fall back to tolerance around observed means over overlapping years
    obs_years <- intersect(unique(obs_biomass_data$Year), comparison_years)
    if (length(obs_years) == 0) {
      # Fallback: use all available years in obs if no overlap
      obs_years <- unique(obs_biomass_data$Year)
      if (verbose) cat("Warning: No overlap between obs years and comparison_years; using all observed years\n")
    }

    obs_bounds <- obs_biomass_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(Year %in% obs_years) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(obs_mean = mean(ObsBiomass, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(lower_bound = obs_mean * (1 - tolerance),
                    upper_bound = obs_mean * (1 + tolerance)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Species, lower_bound, upper_bound)
  }

  # Fast lookup vectors
  lower_by_species <- stats::setNames(obs_bounds$lower_bound, obs_bounds$Species)
  upper_by_species <- stats::setNames(obs_bounds$upper_bound, obs_bounds$Species)

  accepted_idx <- integer(0)
  details <- vector("list", length(sim_results))

  for (i in seq_along(sim_results)) {
    sim <- sim_results[[i]]
    if (is.null(sim) || !inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) next
    bm <- getBiomass(sim)
    yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(bm))
    sel <- yrs %in% comparison_years
    if (!any(sel)) next
    mean_bm <- colMeans(bm[sel, , drop = FALSE])
    species <- names(mean_bm)

    within <- vapply(species, function(sp) {
      if (sp %in% names(lower_by_species)) {
        mb <- mean_bm[[sp]]
        lower <- lower_by_species[[sp]]
        upper <- upper_by_species[[sp]]
        is.finite(mb) && is.finite(lower) && is.finite(upper) && (mb >= lower) && (mb <= upper)
      } else {
        TRUE
      }
    }, logical(1))

    species_with_obs <- species[species %in% names(lower_by_species)]
    failures <- sum(!within[names(within) %in% species_with_obs], na.rm = TRUE)
    ok <- failures <= allow_outside
    if (ok) accepted_idx <- c(accepted_idx, i)
    details[[i]] <- list(accepted = ok, species_within = within, n_failures = failures)
  }

  accepted_results <- sim_results[accepted_idx]
  accepted_parameters <- param_combinations[accepted_idx]

  if (verbose) {
    total <- length(sim_results)
    n_acc <- length(accepted_idx)
    rate <- if (total > 0) 100 * n_acc / total else 0
    cat(sprintf("Accepted %d/%d simulations (%.1f%%)\n", n_acc, total, rate))
    # Optional: quick breakdown of common failures (top 5 species by failure count)
    if (length(details) > 0) {
      # Collect species failure counts across sims with obs
      fail_counts <- list()
      for (d in details) {
        if (!is.null(d) && !is.null(d$species_within)) {
          spw <- d$species_within
          # keep names where within==FALSE
          if (!is.null(names(spw))) {
            bad <- names(spw)[!spw]
            if (length(bad) > 0) {
              for (b in bad) fail_counts[[b]] <- (fail_counts[[b]] %||% 0) + 1
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (length(fail_counts) > 0) {
        fc <- sort(unlist(fail_counts), decreasing = TRUE)
        top <- head(fc, 5)
        cat("Top species failing bounds:",
            paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(top), top), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      }
    }
  }

  list(
    accepted_indices = accepted_idx,
    accepted_results = accepted_results,
    accepted_simulations = accepted_results,      # alias for compatibility
    accepted_params = accepted_parameters,
    accepted_parameters = accepted_parameters,    # alias for compatibility
    rejection_details = details,
    n_accepted = length(accepted_idx),
    acceptance_rate = length(accepted_idx) / max(1, length(sim_results))
  )
}

# Default allowance for this analysis (can be tuned)
allowed_biomass_failures <- 3
```

```{r}
  comparison_years = 2000:2010,
```

## Step 4.5: Monte Carlo Model Assessment (Accepted Simulations)

Let's recreate the baseline assessment plots but using the accepted Monte Carlo simulations with uncertainty ribbons to show the range of plausible model outcomes.

```{r monte-carlo-model-assessment}
cat("=== STARTING MONTE CARLO MODEL ASSESSMENT ===\n")
cat("Checking if we have accepted simulations...\n")
cat("rejection_results$n_accepted:", ifelse(exists("rejection_results"), rejection_results$n_accepted, "rejection_results does not exist"), "\n")

if (rejection_results$n_accepted > 0) {
  cat("=== MONTE CARLO MODEL ASSESSMENT (ACCEPTED SIMULATIONS) ===\n")
  cat("Creating uncertainty plots with", rejection_results$n_accepted, "accepted simulations\n")
  
  # Function to extract and combine biomass data from multiple simulations
  extract_monte_carlo_biomass <- function(sim_list, sim_names = NULL) {
    cat("Extracting biomass from", length(sim_list), "simulations...\n")
    
    if (is.null(sim_names)) {
      sim_names <- paste0("MC_", seq_along(sim_list))
    }
    
    biomass_list <- lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
      sim <- sim_list[[i]]
      cat("Processing simulation", i, "- Class:", class(sim), "\n")
      
      if (!is.null(sim) && inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) {
        tryCatch({
          biomass_matrix <- getBiomass(sim)
          cat("  Biomass matrix dimensions:", dim(biomass_matrix), "\n")
          
          biomass_df <- reshape2::melt(biomass_matrix)
          names(biomass_df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Biomass")
          biomass_df$Simulation <- sim_names[i]
          
          cat("  Extracted biomass data rows:", nrow(biomass_df), "\n")
          return(biomass_df)
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("  Error extracting biomass from simulation", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
          return(NULL)
        })
      } else {
        cat("  Simulation", i, "is NULL or not MizerSim\n")
        return(NULL)
      }
    })
    
    # Remove NULL entries and combine
    biomass_list <- biomass_list[!sapply(biomass_list, is.null)]
    cat("Valid biomass extractions:", length(biomass_list), "\n")
    
    if (length(biomass_list) > 0) {
      combined_data <- do.call(rbind, biomass_list)
      cat("Combined biomass data rows:", nrow(combined_data), "\n")
      return(combined_data)
    } else {
      cat("No valid biomass data extracted\n")
      return(data.frame())
    }
  }
  
  # Function to extract and combine yield data from multiple simulations
  extract_monte_carlo_yield <- function(sim_list, sim_names = NULL) {
    cat("Extracting yield from", length(sim_list), "simulations...\n")
    
    if (is.null(sim_names)) {
      sim_names <- paste0("MC_", seq_along(sim_list))
    }
    
    yield_list <- lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
      sim <- sim_list[[i]]
      cat("Processing simulation", i, "for yield - Class:", class(sim), "\n")
      
      if (!is.null(sim) && inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) {
        tryCatch({
          yield_matrix <- getYield(sim)
          cat("  Yield matrix dimensions:", dim(yield_matrix), "\n")
          
          yield_df <- reshape2::melt(yield_matrix)
          names(yield_df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
          yield_df$Simulation <- sim_names[i]
          
          cat("  Extracted yield data rows:", nrow(yield_df), "\n")
          return(yield_df)
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("  Error extracting yield from simulation", i, ":", e$message, "\n")
          return(NULL)
        })
      } else {
        cat("  Simulation", i, "is NULL or not MizerSim\n")
        return(NULL)
      }
    })
    
    # Remove NULL entries and combine
    yield_list <- yield_list[!sapply(yield_list, is.null)]
    cat("Valid yield extractions:", length(yield_list), "\n")
    
    if (length(yield_list) > 0) {
      combined_data <- do.call(rbind, yield_list)
      cat("Combined yield data rows:", nrow(combined_data), "\n")
      return(combined_data)
    } else {
      cat("No valid yield data extracted\n")
      return(data.frame())
    }
  }
  
  # Extract biomass data from accepted simulations
  cat("Debugging biomass extraction...\n")
  cat("Number of accepted simulations:", length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations), "\n")
  
  # Debug: Check structure of first accepted simulation
  if (length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations) > 0) {
    first_sim <- rejection_results$accepted_simulations[[1]]
    cat("First simulation class:", class(first_sim), "\n")
    cat("First simulation is MizerSim?", inherits(first_sim, "MizerSim"), "\n")
    if (inherits(first_sim, "MizerSim")) {
      cat("First simulation dimensions:", dim(getBiomass(first_sim)), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  mc_biomass_data <- extract_monte_carlo_biomass(rejection_results$accepted_simulations)
  cat("Extracted biomass data rows:", nrow(mc_biomass_data), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(mc_biomass_data) > 0) {
    cat("Sample of biomass data:\n")
    print(head(mc_biomass_data))
    cat("Species in biomass data:", unique(mc_biomass_data$Species), "\n")
    cat("Year range in biomass data:", range(mc_biomass_data$Year), "\n")
    # Calculate uncertainty bounds for biomass
    cat("Calculating biomass uncertainty bounds...\n")
    biomass_uncertainty <- mc_biomass_data %>%
      group_by(Year, Species) %>%
      summarise(
        median = median(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        q05 = quantile(Biomass, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(Biomass, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(Biomass, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        q95 = quantile(Biomass, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean = mean(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_sims = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))
    
    cat("Biomass uncertainty summary:\n")
    cat("Number of Year-Species combinations:", nrow(biomass_uncertainty), "\n")
    cat("Number of simulations per combination:", unique(biomass_uncertainty$n_sims), "\n")
    if (nrow(biomass_uncertainty) > 0) {
      cat("Sample uncertainty values:\n")
      print(head(biomass_uncertainty))
    }
    
    # Create observation data for plotting
    # Join species-specific bounds and expand across plotting years
    bounds_df <- obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g, RangeSource)
    obs_biomass_ts <- obs_biomass_data %>%
      left_join(bounds_df, by = "Species") %>%
  tidyr::crossing(Year = 2000:2010) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))
    
  # Monte Carlo biomass plot with uncertainty ribbons
    cat("Creating biomass plot...\n")
    p_biomass_mc <- ggplot()
    
    # Only add ribbons if we have multiple simulations (otherwise q05=q95=median)
  if (max(biomass_uncertainty$n_sims) > 1) {
      p_biomass_mc <- p_biomass_mc +
        # Add uncertainty ribbons (90% and 50% intervals)
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_uncertainty, 
          aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), 
          alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_uncertainty, 
          aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), 
          alpha = 0.3)
    }
    
    # Always add the line (median or single simulation value)
    p_biomass_mc <- p_biomass_mc +
    geom_line(data = biomass_uncertainty, 
        aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), 
                linewidth = 1.2) +
      # Add observed data points and uncertainty
      geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass, color = .data$Species), 
                 size = 1.2, shape = 16) +
      geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass), 
                 shape = 1, size = 1.2, colour = "black") +
  geom_ribbon(data = obs_biomass_ts, 
    aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$Lower, ymax = .data$Upper), 
      alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray50") +
      # Styling
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::number(x/1e6)) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Biomass [t]", 
       title = paste("Monte Carlo: Biomass vs Observations (", length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations), " sims)"),
           subtitle = paste("Based on", rejection_results$n_accepted, "accepted simulations (dark = 50% CI, light = 90% CI)")) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(1961, 2010), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
    
    print(p_biomass_mc)
    
    # Save plot
    # ggsave("monte_carlo_biomass_uncertainty_post_v009.png", p_biomass_mc, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  # Extract yield data from accepted simulations
  cat("Debugging yield extraction...\n")
  mc_yield_data <- extract_monte_carlo_yield(rejection_results$accepted_simulations)
  cat("Extracted yield data rows:", nrow(mc_yield_data), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(mc_yield_data) > 0) {
    cat("Sample of yield data:\n")
    print(head(mc_yield_data))
    cat("Species in yield data:", unique(mc_yield_data$Species), "\n")
    cat("Year range in yield data:", range(mc_yield_data$Year), "\n")
  }
  
  if (nrow(mc_yield_data) > 0 && exists("yield_ts_tidy")) {
    cat("Calculating yield uncertainty bounds (baseline style)...\n")
    # Prepare combined MC yield and compute uncertainty
    mc_yield <- mc_yield_data %>% mutate(Yield = pmax(Yield, 0))
    species_with_yield <- mc_yield %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarise(max_yield = max(Yield, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>% filter(max_yield > 0) %>% pull(Species)
    cat("Accepted sims: species with fishing yields:", paste(species_with_yield, collapse = ", "), "\n")

    yield_uncertainty <- mc_yield %>%
      filter(Species %in% species_with_yield) %>%
      group_by(Year, Species) %>%
      summarise(
        median = median(Yield, na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(Yield, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(Yield, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        q05 = quantile(Yield, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        q95 = quantile(Yield, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

    # Observed positive-yield presence by year/species
    obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
      mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>%
      group_by(Year, Species) %>%
      summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

    # Filter modeled zeros only in years without observed positive yield
    yield_uncertainty <- yield_uncertainty %>%
      left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by = c("Year", "Species")) %>%
      mutate(has_obs_pos = coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))

    yield_uncertainty_ribbon <- yield_uncertainty %>%
      filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(q95) | q95 <= 0))) %>%
      mutate(
        q05 = ifelse(q05 > 0, q05, NA_real_),
        q25 = ifelse(q25 > 0, q25, NA_real_),
        q75 = ifelse(q75 > 0, q75, NA_real_),
        q95 = ifelse(q95 > 0, q95, NA_real_)
      ) %>%
      filter(!(is.na(q25) & is.na(q75) & is.na(q05) & is.na(q95)))

    yield_uncertainty_line <- yield_uncertainty %>%
      filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(median) | median <= 0))) %>%
      mutate(median = ifelse(median > 0, median, NA_real_))

    # Observed yields filtered to species with modeled yields
    yield_obs_filtered <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
      filter(Species %in% species_with_yield, Yield > 0) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

    # Determine plotting x-range
    baleen_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>%
      filter(Species == "baleen whales") %>%
      summarise(min_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      pull(min_year)
    global_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>% summarise(min_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(min_year)
    start_year <- if (!is.null(baleen_start_obs) && length(baleen_start_obs) == 1 && is.finite(baleen_start_obs)) {
      baleen_start_obs
    } else if (!is.null(global_start_obs) && length(global_start_obs) == 1 && is.finite(global_start_obs)) {
      global_start_obs
    } else { 1930 }
    end_year <- max(yield_uncertainty$Year, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Custom label: no decimals for >=1; dynamic decimals for <1 so first non-zero digit shows
    label_dynamic_decimals <- function(x) {
      sci <- scales::label_scientific(digits = 1)
      vapply(x, function(v) {
        if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
        if (v <= 0) return("0")
        vt <- v / 1e6  # convert grams -> tonnes
        if (vt >= 1) {
          paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), " t")
        } else if (vt < 1e-6) {
          paste0(sci(vt), " t")
        } else {
          dp <- max(1, ceiling(-log10(vt)))
          dp <- min(dp, 6)
          paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = dp), " t")
        }
      }, character(1))
    }

    # Plot in baseline style (log10 y, ribbons, observed overlays)
    p_yield_mc <- ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(data = yield_uncertainty_line, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), linewidth = 1.0, linetype = "solid", lineend = "round") +
      geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield, colour = .data$Species), size = 1) +
      geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield), shape = 1, size = 1, colour = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 1961, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 2010, linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 6), labels = label_dynamic_decimals) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(start_year, end_year)) +
      facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
      labs(x = "Year", y = "Yield [t/year]", title = paste("Monte Carlo: Yield vs Observations (", length(rejection_results$accepted_simulations), " sims)"))

    print(p_yield_mc)

     #ggsave("yield_uncertainty_post_monte_carlo_results_nsims_3000_SD_2_4_3_tol_0.0025_tmax_1500.png", p_yield_mc, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300) 
  }
  
  # Summary statistics for uncertainty assessment
  if (nrow(mc_biomass_data) > 0) {
    cat("\n=== UNCERTAINTY SUMMARY ===\n")
    
    # Calculate uncertainty metrics for the final period (2005-2010)
    final_period_biomass <- mc_biomass_data %>%
      filter(Year >= 2005, Year <= 2010) %>%
      group_by(Species) %>%
      summarise(
        median_biomass = median(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        cv = sd(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_biomass = min(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_biomass = max(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        uncertainty_range = max(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / min(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
    
    cat("Biomass uncertainty summary (2005-2010):\n")
    print(final_period_biomass %>% 
          arrange(desc(cv)) %>%
          mutate(cv = round(cv, 3), uncertainty_range = round(uncertainty_range, 2)))
    
    cat("\nSpecies with highest uncertainty (CV > 0.5):\n")
    high_uncertainty <- final_period_biomass %>% 
      filter(cv > 0.5) %>% 
      arrange(desc(cv))
    if (nrow(high_uncertainty) > 0) {
      print(high_uncertainty)
    } else {
      cat("No species with CV > 0.5\n")
    }
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No accepted simulations available for Monte Carlo assessment.\n")
}
```

## Step 5: Compare Modeled vs Observed (Accepted Simulations Only)

Finally, let's compare the biomass and yield from our accepted simulations with observations.

```{r compare-accepted-simulations}
if (rejection_results$n_accepted > 0) {
  cat("=== COMPARING ACCEPTED SIMULATIONS WITH OBSERVATIONS ===\n")
  
  # Extract yield and biomass data from accepted simulations
  accepted_yield_data <- extract_simulation_data(rejection_results$accepted_simulations, "yield")
  accepted_biomass_data <- extract_simulation_data(rejection_results$accepted_simulations, "biomass")
  
  # Function to calculate uncertainty bounds
  calculate_uncertainty_bounds <- function(data, group_cols, value_col) {
    data %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
      summarise(
        mean = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        q25 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q75 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        q05 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        q95 = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
        min = min(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  }
  
  # Calculate yield uncertainty bounds
  yield_bounds <- calculate_uncertainty_bounds(accepted_yield_data, c("Year", "Species"), "Yield")
  
  # Calculate biomass uncertainty bounds  
  biomass_bounds <- calculate_uncertainty_bounds(accepted_biomass_data, c("Year", "Species"), "Biomass")
  
  # Plot yield comparison with uncertainty bounds
  p_yield_accepted <- ggplot() +
    # Add uncertainty ribbons
    geom_ribbon(data = yield_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = yield_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.4) +
    # Add median line
    geom_line(data = yield_bounds, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), linewidth = 1) +
    # Add observed data points
    geom_point(data = yield_ts_tidy, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield, color = .data$Species), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(data = yield_ts_tidy, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield), shape = 1, size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
    # Styling
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(
      title = "Accepted Simulations: Yield vs Observations",
      subtitle = paste("n =", rejection_results$n_accepted, "simulations passing biomass criteria"),
      x = "Year", y = "Yield"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1961, 2010), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
  
  print(p_yield_accepted)
  
  # Plot biomass comparison with uncertainty bounds
  p_biomass_accepted <- ggplot() +
    # Add uncertainty ribbons
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_bounds, 
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.4) +
    # Add median line
    geom_line(data = biomass_bounds, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), linewidth = 1) +
    # Add observed data (2010-2020 period)
  geom_point(data = obs_biomass_data %>% left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g), by = "Species") %>% tidyr::crossing(Year = 2005:2010), 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass, color = .data$Species), size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = obs_biomass_data %>% left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g), by = "Species") %>% tidyr::crossing(Year = 2005:2010), 
         aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass), shape = 1, size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
    # Styling
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Species") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(
      title = "Accepted Simulations: Biomass vs Observations", 
      subtitle = paste("n =", rejection_results$n_accepted, "simulations passing biomass criteria"),
      x = "Year", y = "Biomass"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1961, 2010), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
  
  print(p_biomass_accepted)
  
  # Save results for future use (commented out for testing)
  # saveRDS(rejection_results, "biomass_filtered_uncertainty_results.RDS")
  cat("\n(Results not saved during testing - uncomment saveRDS line for production)\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Cannot create comparison plots - no simulations passed rejection criteria.\n")
  cat("Consider:\n")
  cat("1. Increasing tolerance (currently 25%)\n") 
  cat("2. Relaxing rejection criteria (allow some species to be outside bounds)\n")
  cat("3. Increasing number of simulations\n")
}
```

# Step 6: Combine Monte Carlo Results from Multiple Files

```{r combine-monte-carlo-results, eval=FALSE}
# This function can be used to aggregate results from multiple Monte Carlo simulation result files.
# Combine successful simulations and metadata across saved Monte Carlo result files
combine_successful_sims <- function(
  mc_dir = file.path("Output_large_files", "monte_carlo_results"),
  pattern = "^monte_carlo_results.*\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  out_subdir = "combined_simulation_results",
  out_basename = paste0("combined_successful_sims_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")),
  exclude_combined = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(tibble)
  })
  # Helper for NULL-coalesce
  `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
  if (!dir.exists(mc_dir)) stop("Monte Carlo directory not found: ", mc_dir)
  # Discover files only inside mc_dir
  files <- list.files(mc_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE, recursive = recursive)
  # Optionally exclude previously combined outputs
  if (exclude_combined) {
    files <- files[!grepl(out_subdir, files, fixed = TRUE)]
  }
  if (length(files) == 0) stop("No Monte Carlo results files found in ", mc_dir)
  if (verbose) cat("Found", length(files), "result files in", mc_dir, "\n")

  # Containers
  all_sims <- list()
  all_params <- list()
  sim_keys <- character()

  make_run_id <- function(obj, fname) {
    if (!is.null(obj$settings) && is.list(obj$settings)) {
      s <- obj$settings
      paste0(
        "nsims=", s$total_sims %||% NA,
        ";sd=", s$catchability_sd %||% NA, "_", s$abundance_sd %||% NA, "_", s$gamma_sd %||% NA,
        ";tol=", s$enhanced_steady_tol %||% NA, ";tmax=", s$enhanced_steady_t_max %||% NA
      )
    } else {
      basename(fname)
    }
  }

  # Read and collect
  for (f in files) {
    obj <- try(readRDS(f), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(obj, "try-error")) { if (verbose) cat("Skipping unreadable:", f, "\n"); next }
    if (!is.list(obj) || is.null(obj$simulations) || is.null(obj$parameters)) {
      if (verbose) cat("Skipping non-results object:", f, "\n")
      next
    }
    sims <- obj$simulations
    params <- obj$parameters
    if (!length(sims) || !length(params)) next

    run_id <- make_run_id(obj, f)

    for (i in seq_along(sims)) {
      s <- sims[[i]]; p <- params[[i]]
      if (is.null(s) || is.null(p)) next
      key <- paste0(run_id, "::", (p$sim_id %||% i))
      all_sims[[length(all_sims)+1L]] <- s
      all_params[[length(all_params)+1L]] <- c(p, list(run_id = run_id, source_file = f, sim_key = key))
      sim_keys[length(sim_keys)+1L] <- key
    }
  }

  # Build parameter tibble (list-columns for vectors)
  param_tbl <- tibble(
    sim_key = sim_keys,
    run_id = sapply(all_params, `[[`, "run_id"),
    source_file = sapply(all_params, `[[`, "source_file"),
    sim_id_within_file = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$sim_id %||% NA_integer_),
    stable = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$stable %||% NA),
    max_cv = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$max_cv %||% NA_real_),
    species_names = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "species_names"),
    abundance_scaling = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "abundance_scaling"),
    gamma_change = lapply(all_params, function(x) x$gamma_change %||% x$gamma_change_raw %||% NA),
    catchability = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "catchability"),
    catchability_change = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "catchability_change")
  )

  # Flat summary CSV (no heavy list columns)
  flat_summary <- param_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      sim_key, run_id, source_file, sim_id_within_file, stable, max_cv,
      n_species = vapply(species_names, length, integer(1)),
      mean_gamma_mult = vapply(gamma_change, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
      mean_abund_mult = vapply(abundance_scaling, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)),
      mean_catchability = vapply(catchability, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
    )

  # Save combined artifact
  # Prepare output paths (nested under mc_dir/out_subdir)
  out_dir <- file.path(mc_dir, out_subdir)
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  out_rds <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_basename, ".rds"))
  out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("combined_successful_params_summary_", substring(out_basename, 1 + nchar("combined_successful_sims_")), ".csv"))

  # Build object compatible with earlier monte_carlo_results structure for downstream reuse
  combined <- list(
    simulations = all_sims,
    parameters = all_params,              # keep raw list for compatibility with code expecting $parameters as list
    parameters_table = param_tbl,         # add tidy table version
    flat_summary = flat_summary,
    n_successful = length(all_sims),
    n_attempts = length(all_sims),
    failed = list(),
    settings = list(combined_from = files, combined_at = Sys.time()),
    created = Sys.time()
  )
  saveRDS(combined, out_rds)
  utils::write.csv(flat_summary, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

  if (verbose) {
    cat("Saved combined successful sims to subfolder:\n - RDS:", out_rds, "\n - CSV:", out_csv,
        "\nTotal successes:", length(all_sims), "\n")
  }
  invisible(combined)
}

# Run it
combined_success <- combine_successful_sims()
```

```{r combined-mc-quick-assessment, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Purpose: Reproduce Steps 1.4 -> 5 (uncertainty, biomass rejection, post-rejection plots)
# using a previously combined results file produced by combine_successful_sims().

suppressPackageStartupMessages({

})

# 1. Locate newest combined file if combined_success not already in memory

  comb_dir <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results")
  cand <- list.files(comb_dir, pattern = '^combined_successful_sims_.*\\.rds$', full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(cand)) stop("No combined_successful_sims_*.rds files found.")

# 2. For compatibility with earlier workflow, create monte_carlo_results alias
monte_carlo_results <- combined_success

# 3. Ensure observed datasets present

if (!exists("obs_biomass_data")) stop("'obs_biomass_data' must be defined earlier (see baseline-assessment chunk).")
if (!exists("obs_biomass_bounds")) stop("'obs_biomass_bounds' must be defined earlier (see baseline-assessment chunk).")

species_order <- levels(obs_biomass_bounds$Species)

# 4. Extract valid simulations
sims_all <- monte_carlo_results$simulations
valid_sims <- Filter(function(x) inherits(x, "MizerSim") && !any(is.nan(x@n)) && !any(is.infinite(x@n)), sims_all)
cat("Valid simulations:", length(valid_sims), "of", length(sims_all),"\n")
if (!length(valid_sims)) stop("No valid simulations to assess.")

extract_series <- function(sim_list, what = c("biomass","yield")) {
  what <- match.arg(what)
  getter <- if (what == "biomass") getBiomass else getYield
  val_name <- if (what == "biomass") "Biomass" else "Yield"
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i){
    mat <- getter(sim_list[[i]])
    df <- melt(mat); names(df) <- c("Year","Species", val_name)
    df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year))
    df$Species <- as.character(df$Species)
    df$sim_id <- i
    df
  }))
}

mc_biomass <- extract_series(valid_sims, "biomass")
mc_yield   <- extract_series(valid_sims, "yield") %>% mutate(Yield = pmax(Yield,0))

# Identify species with any positive yield across all sims and restrict
species_with_yield <- mc_yield %>%
  group_by(Species) %>% summarise(max_yield = max(Yield, na.rm = TRUE), .groups='drop') %>%
  filter(max_yield > 0) %>% pull(Species)
mc_yield <- mc_yield %>% filter(Species %in% species_with_yield)

# 5. Build uncertainty summaries (median & quantiles)
summarise_uncertainty <- function(df, value_col){
  df %>% group_by(Year, Species) %>% summarise(
    median = median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm=TRUE),
    q25    = quantile(.data[[value_col]],0.25, na.rm=TRUE),
    q75    = quantile(.data[[value_col]],0.75, na.rm=TRUE),
    q05    = quantile(.data[[value_col]],0.05, na.rm=TRUE),
    q95    = quantile(.data[[value_col]],0.95, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups='drop') %>% mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))
}

biomass_unc <- summarise_uncertainty(mc_biomass, "Biomass")
yield_unc   <- summarise_uncertainty(mc_yield,   "Yield")

# Build observed yield subset (positive yields only, matching species retained)

  filter(Species %in% species_with_yield, Yield > 0) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

plot_uncertainty_panel <- function(unc_df, value = c("Biomass","Yield"), title, to_tonnes = FALSE){
  value <- match.arg(value)

  scale_y <- if (to_tonnes) scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::number(x/1e6)) else scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number())

print(plot_uncertainty_panel(biomass_unc, "Biomass", sprintf("Combined MC Biomass (%d sims)", length(valid_sims)), to_tonnes = TRUE))

# Yield plot (custom to match earlier monte-carlo-model-assessment style)
label_dynamic_decimals <- function(x) {
  sci <- scales::label_scientific(digits = 1)
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
    if (v <= 0) return("0")
    vt <- v / 1e6  # grams -> tonnes
    if (vt >= 1) {
      paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), " t")
    } else if (vt < 1e-6) {
      paste0(sci(vt), " t")
    } else {
      dp <- max(1, ceiling(-log10(vt)))
      dp <- min(dp, 6)
      paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = dp), " t")
    }
  }, character(1))
}

# 7. Construct observed biomass timeseries for rejection (match earlier logic)
obs_biomass_ts <- obs_biomass_data %>%
  left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g), by = "Species") %>%
  tidyr::crossing(Year = 2000:2010)

# 8. Biomass rejection function (simplified)
apply_biomass_rejection_quick <- function(sim_list, obs_ts, tolerance = 0.5, comparison_years = 2000:2010, allow_outside = 3) {
  accepted <- list(); details <- vector("list", length(sim_list))
  lower_by <- tapply(obs_ts$Lower, obs_ts$Species, median, na.rm=TRUE)
  upper_by <- tapply(obs_ts$Upper, obs_ts$Species, median, na.rm=TRUE)
  for (i in seq_along(sim_list)) {
    sim <- sim_list[[i]]; bm <- getBiomass(sim)
    yrs <- intersect(comparison_years, as.numeric(rownames(bm)))
    mid <- apply(bm[as.character(yrs), , drop=FALSE], 2, median, na.rm=TRUE)
    within <- vapply(names(mid), function(sp){
      m <- mid[[sp]]; lo <- lower_by[[sp]]; hi <- upper_by[[sp]]
      if (is.finite(m) && !is.na(lo) && !is.na(hi)) (m >= (1 - tolerance)*lo) && (m <= (1 + tolerance)*hi) else TRUE
    }, logical(1))
    failures <- sum(!within)
    ok <- failures <= allow_outside
    if (ok) accepted[[length(accepted)+1L]] <- sim
    details[[i]] <- list(accepted = ok, failures = failures, within = within)
  }
  list(accepted_simulations = accepted, n_accepted = length(accepted), details = details)
}

rejection <- apply_biomass_rejection_quick(valid_sims, obs_biomass_ts, tolerance = 0.5, comparison_years = 2000:2010, allow_outside = 3)

    geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, aes(x = Year, y = ObsBiomass, colour = Species), size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, aes(x = Year, y = ObsBiomass), shape = 1, size = 0.8, colour = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +

    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Biomass [t]", title = sprintf("Accepted Biomass (%d sims)", rejection$n_accepted))
  print(accepted_biomass_plot)

  # Accepted yield filtering for zero-effort years
  acc_obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
    mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>%
    group_by(Year, Species) %>%
    summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups='drop')
  acc_y_unc_f <- acc_y_unc %>%
    left_join(acc_obs_pos_by_year, by = c("Year","Species")) %>%
    mutate(has_obs_pos = coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))
  acc_y_unc_ribbon <- acc_y_unc_f %>% filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(q95) | q95 <= 0)))
  acc_y_unc_line   <- acc_y_unc_f %>% filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(median) | median <= 0))) %>% mutate(median = ifelse(median>0, median, NA_real_))

  acc_yield_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = acc_y_unc_ribbon, aes(x = Year, ymin = q05, ymax = q95, fill = Species), alpha = 0.20) +
    geom_ribbon(data = acc_y_unc_ribbon, aes(x = Year, ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = Species), alpha = 0.30) +
    geom_line(data = acc_y_unc_line, aes(x = Year, y = median, colour = Species), linewidth = 1.0, lineend = "round") +
    geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = Year, y = Yield, colour = Species), size = 1) +
    geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = Year, y = Yield), shape = 1, size = 1, colour = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1961, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2010, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 6), labels = label_dynamic_decimals) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(start_year, end_year)) +
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Yield [t/year]", title = sprintf("Accepted Yield (%d sims)", rejection$n_accepted))
  print(acc_yield_plot)
} else {
  message("No simulations passed biomass rejection criteria.")
}

``` 





### Methodology Overview (Replicated Steps 1.4–5 + Extensions)

This relocated block restores the full combined Monte Carlo assessment narrative:

Core workflow:
1. Scope & validity (Step 1.4): filter invalid `MizerSim`, extract annual biomass & yield, compute median + 5/25/75/95% quantiles.
2. Diagnostics (Step 1.5): quick field presence & parameter spread checks.
3. Parameter distributions (Step 2): gamma (log10), catchability_change, abundance_scaling – faceted per species.
4. Biomass rejection (Step 3): mean biomass 2000–2010 vs bounds in `obs_biomass_bounds`; accept if ≤ `allow_outside` species outside range (here 3).
5. Accepted reassessment (Step 4.5): recompute uncertainty ribbons & median lines for accepted subset.
6. Observation comparison (Step 5): accepted envelopes vs observed biomass/yield with consistent styling (dual ribbons, log yield, dashed ref years).

Extensions:
7. Post‑rejection parameter diagnostics: accepted-only distributions to show contraction.
8. Seed exports: mean, median, random-draw (timestamped) plus long-form and summary tables to bootstrap new focused MC rounds.

Styling & handling details:
- Yield axis in tonnes (log10) with dynamic labels; biomass displayed as tonnes via axis label division (internal units untouched).
- Zero‑effort bridging hides ribbons/lines for year/species cells lacking positive observed yields unless simulated quantiles > 0.
- Upstream randomization uses log-normal factors (median=1, mean>1) — so while central tendency is neutral, expectation is upward-skewed; interpret “more likely increases” in that statistical sense.
- Random seed for random-draw export derived from timestamp; replace with stored integer if exact reproducibility required.
- Future options: alternative acceptance rules (e.g., proportion outside), covariance-aware seed construction, percentile-based seed sets.

## Combined Results: Full Monte Carlo Assessment Workflow (Replicated Steps 1.4 -> 5)

The section below is the relocated full combined assessment (previously earlier in the document). It reproduces the original single‑batch Monte Carlo workflow (Steps 1.4 → 5) on the merged multi‑batch object `combined_success` and extends it with post‑rejection diagnostics and multi-seed parameter exports. (Quick assessment earlier in document remains for fast iteration.)

```{r combined-montecarlo-assessment-full, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(reshape2); library(tidyr)
})

`%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# 0. Ensure combined_success available
if (!exists("combined_success")) {
  comb_dir <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results")
  cf <- list.files(comb_dir, pattern = '^combined_successful_sims_.*\\.rds$', full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(cf)) stop("No combined_successful_sims_*.rds files found for full assessment.")
  newest <- cf[order(file.info(cf)$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]
  message("Loading combined results: ", newest)
  combined_success <- readRDS(newest)
}
monte_carlo_results <- combined_success

species_order <- levels(obs_biomass_bounds$Species)

cat("=== FULL COMBINED MONTE CARLO ASSESSMENT (RELOCATED) ===\n")
sims_all <- monte_carlo_results$simulations
valid_sims <- Filter(function(x){ inherits(x, "MizerSim") && !any(is.nan(x@n)) && !any(is.infinite(x@n)) }, sims_all)
cat("Using", length(valid_sims), "valid simulations of", length(sims_all), "total\n")
if (!length(valid_sims)) stop("No valid simulations")

extract_monte_carlo_biomass <- function(sim_list){
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i){
    m <- getBiomass(sim_list[[i]]); df <- melt(m); names(df) <- c("Year","Species","Biomass")
    df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year)); df$Species <- as.character(df$Species); df$sim_id <- i; df
  }))
}
extract_monte_carlo_yield <- function(sim_list){
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i){
    m <- getYield(sim_list[[i]]); df <- melt(m); names(df) <- c("Year","Species","Yield")
    df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year)); df$Species <- as.character(df$Species); df$sim_id <- i; df
  }))
}

mc_biomass <- extract_monte_carlo_biomass(valid_sims)
biomass_uncertainty <- mc_biomass %>% group_by(Year, Species) %>% summarise(median=median(Biomass,na.rm=TRUE), q25=quantile(Biomass,0.25,na.rm=TRUE), q75=quantile(Biomass,0.75,na.rm=TRUE), q05=quantile(Biomass,0.05,na.rm=TRUE), q95=quantile(Biomass,0.95,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>% mutate(Species=factor(Species, levels=species_order))

obs_biomass_ts <- obs_biomass_data %>% left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g), by="Species") %>% tidyr::crossing(Year = 2000:2010) %>% mutate(Species=factor(Species, levels=species_order))

mc_yield <- extract_monte_carlo_yield(valid_sims) %>% mutate(Yield = pmax(Yield,0))
species_with_yield <- mc_yield %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarise(mx = max(Yield, na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>% filter(mx>0) %>% pull(Species)
cat("Species with fishing yields:", paste(species_with_yield, collapse=", "), "\n")

yield_uncertainty <- mc_yield %>% filter(Species %in% species_with_yield) %>% group_by(Year, Species) %>% summarise(median=median(Yield,na.rm=TRUE), q25=quantile(Yield,0.25,na.rm=TRUE), q75=quantile(Yield,0.75,na.rm=TRUE), q05=quantile(Yield,0.05,na.rm=TRUE), q95=quantile(Yield,0.95,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>% mutate(Species=factor(Species, levels=species_order))

obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>% mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield>0) %>% group_by(Year, Species) %>% summarise(has_obs_pos=any(has_obs_pos,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop')
yield_uncertainty <- yield_uncertainty %>% left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by=c("Year","Species")) %>% mutate(has_obs_pos=coalesce(has_obs_pos,FALSE))
yield_uncertainty_ribbon <- yield_uncertainty %>% filter(!(has_obs_pos==FALSE & (is.na(q95) | q95<=0))) %>% mutate(q05=ifelse(q05>0,q05,NA_real_), q25=ifelse(q25>0,q25,NA_real_), q75=ifelse(q75>0,q75,NA_real_), q95=ifelse(q95>0,q95,NA_real_)) %>% filter(!(is.na(q25)&is.na(q75)&is.na(q05)&is.na(q95)))
yield_uncertainty_line <- yield_uncertainty %>% filter(!(has_obs_pos==FALSE & (is.na(median) | median<=0))) %>% mutate(median=ifelse(median>0,median,NA_real_))
yield_obs_filtered <- yield_ts_tidy %>% filter(Species %in% species_with_yield, Yield>0) %>% mutate(Species=factor(Species, levels=species_order))

baleen_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>% filter(Species=="baleen whales") %>% summarise(min_year=min(Year,na.rm=TRUE)) %>% pull(min_year)
global_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>% summarise(min_year=min(Year,na.rm=TRUE)) %>% pull(min_year)
start_year <- if (is.finite(baleen_start_obs)) baleen_start_obs else if (is.finite(global_start_obs)) global_start_obs else 1930
end_year <- max(yield_uncertainty$Year, na.rm=TRUE)

label_dynamic_decimals <- function(x){
  sci <- scales::label_scientific(digits=1)
  vapply(x, function(v){ if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_); if (v<=0) return("0"); vt<-v/1e6; if (vt>=1) paste0(formatC(vt, format="f", digits=0, big.mark=",")," t") else if (vt<1e-6) paste0(sci(vt)," t") else {dp<-max(1, ceiling(-log10(vt))); dp<-min(dp,6); paste0(formatC(vt, format="f", digits=dp)," t")} }, character(1))
}

plot_combined_yield <- function(){ ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data=yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x=Year, ymin=q05, ymax=q95, fill=Species), alpha=0.2) +

  scale_y_log10(breaks=scales::log_breaks(n=6), labels=label_dynamic_decimals) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(start_year,end_year)) + facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none", strip.text=element_text(face="bold")) + labs(x="Year", y="Yield [t/year]", title=paste("Combined MC: Yield (", length(valid_sims), " sims)")) }

print(plot_combined_biomass()); print(plot_combined_yield())

plot_parameter_distributions <- function(param_list, param_type = c("catchability","abundance"), title_suffix=""){
  param_type <- match.arg(param_type); extractor <- if (param_type=="catchability") "catchability_change" else "abundance_scaling"
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_list), function(i){ p<-param_list[[i]]; v<-p[[extractor]]; sp<-p$species_names; if (is.null(v)||is.null(sp)) return(NULL); data.frame(sim_id=i, species=sp, value=as.numeric(v)) }))
  if (is.null(df)||!nrow(df)) return(ggplot()+labs(title=paste(param_type,"distribution",title_suffix), subtitle="No data"))
  ggplot(df, aes(x=value)) + geom_histogram(bins=40, fill="steelblue", colour="black", alpha=0.7) + facet_wrap(~species, scales="free_y") + theme_bw() + theme(strip.text=element_text(size=7, face="bold")) + labs(title=paste(param_type, "distribution", title_suffix), x=param_type, y="Frequency")
}

plot_gamma_distribution_fixed <- function(param_combinations, title_suffix = "") {
  gamma_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_combinations), function(i){ p<-param_combinations[[i]]; if (is.null(p)) return(NULL); val <- if (!is.null(p$gamma_change_raw)) p$gamma_change_raw else p$gamma_change; if (is.null(val)) return(NULL); data.frame(sim_id=i, species=p$species_names, gamma_change=val) }))
  if (is.null(gamma_data)||!nrow(gamma_data)) return(ggplot()+labs(title=paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle="No data"))
  gamma_data <- gamma_data %>% filter(is.finite(gamma_change), gamma_change>0) %>% mutate(log10_gamma=log10(gamma_change))
  if (!nrow(gamma_data)) return(ggplot()+labs(title=paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle="No positive values"))
  rng <- quantile(gamma_data$log10_gamma, c(0.01,0.99), na.rm=TRUE); if (!all(is.finite(rng))||diff(rng)==0) rng <- range(gamma_data$log10_gamma)
  pad <- max(0.05, diff(rng)*0.05); xmin <- floor(rng[1]-pad); xmax <- ceiling(rng[2]+pad); bw <- max(0.05,(xmax-xmin)/60); breaks <- seq(floor(xmin), ceiling(xmax))
  ggplot(gamma_data, aes(x=log10_gamma)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=bw, fill="steelblue", alpha=0.7, colour="black") + facet_wrap(~species, scales="free_y") + scale_x_continuous(breaks=breaks, labels=function(x) scales::math_format(10^.x)(x)) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(xmin,xmax)) + theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=7), strip.text=element_text(size=7,face="bold")) + labs(title=paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), x="Gamma Change Factor (log10)", y="Frequency") + geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", colour="red", alpha=0.8, linewidth=0.6)
}

cat("\n=== PARAMETER DISTRIBUTIONS (PRE-REJECTION) ===\n")
print(plot_gamma_distribution_fixed(monte_carlo_results$parameters, title_suffix="(Pre-Rejection)"))
print(plot_parameter_distributions(monte_carlo_results$parameters, param_type="catchability", title_suffix="(Pre-Rejection)"))
print(plot_parameter_distributions(monte_carlo_results$parameters, param_type="abundance", title_suffix="(Pre-Rejection)"))

apply_biomass_rejection_criteria <- function(sim_results, param_combinations, obs_biomass_data, tolerance=0.5, comparison_years=2000:2010, verbose=TRUE, allow_outside=3, obs_bounds_table=NULL){
  if (!is.null(obs_bounds_table)) { obs_bounds <- obs_bounds_table %>% transmute(Species, lower_bound=Lower_g, upper_bound=Upper_g) } else { obs_bounds <- obs_biomass_bounds %>% transmute(Species, lower_bound=Lower_g, upper_bound=Upper_g) }
  lower_by <- setNames(obs_bounds$lower_bound, obs_bounds$Species); upper_by <- setNames(obs_bounds$upper_bound, obs_bounds$Species)
  accepted_idx <- integer(0); details <- vector("list", length(sim_results))
  for (i in seq_along(sim_results)) { sim <- sim_results[[i]]; if (is.null(sim)||!inherits(sim,"MizerSim")) next; bm <- getBiomass(sim); yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(bm)); sel <- yrs %in% comparison_years; if (!any(sel)) next; mean_bm <- colMeans(bm[sel,,drop=FALSE]); sp <- names(mean_bm); within <- vapply(sp, function(spp){ if (spp %in% names(lower_by)) { mb<-mean_bm[[spp]]; lo<-lower_by[[spp]]; hi<-upper_by[[spp]]; is.finite(mb)&&mb>=lo&&mb<=hi } else TRUE }, logical(1)); failures <- sum(!within[sp %in% names(lower_by)], na.rm=TRUE); ok <- failures <= allow_outside; if (ok) accepted_idx <- c(accepted_idx,i); details[[i]] <- list(accepted=ok, n_failures=failures) }
  list(accepted_indices=accepted_idx, accepted_simulations=sim_results[accepted_idx], accepted_parameters=param_combinations[accepted_idx], n_accepted=length(accepted_idx), acceptance_rate=length(accepted_idx)/max(1,length(sim_results)), rejection_details=details)
}

rejection_results <- apply_biomass_rejection_criteria(monte_carlo_results$simulations, monte_carlo_results$parameters, obs_biomass_ts, tolerance=0.5, comparison_years=2000:2010, allow_outside=3, obs_bounds_table=obs_biomass_bounds)
cat("Accepted sims:", rejection_results$n_accepted, "(", round(100*rejection_results$acceptance_rate,1), "%)\n", sep="")

if (rejection_results$n_accepted>0){
  acc_biomass <- extract_monte_carlo_biomass(rejection_results$accepted_simulations)
  acc_yield <- extract_monte_carlo_yield(rejection_results$accepted_simulations) %>% mutate(Yield=pmax(Yield,0))
  acc_bu <- acc_biomass %>% group_by(Year, Species) %>% summarise(median=median(Biomass,na.rm=TRUE), q05=quantile(Biomass,0.05,na.rm=TRUE), q25=quantile(Biomass,0.25,na.rm=TRUE), q75=quantile(Biomass,0.75,na.rm=TRUE), q95=quantile(Biomass,0.95,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>% mutate(Species=factor(Species, levels=species_order))
  species_with_yield_acc <- acc_yield %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarise(mx=max(Yield,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>% filter(mx>0) %>% pull(Species)
  acc_yu <- acc_yield %>% filter(Species %in% species_with_yield_acc) %>% group_by(Year, Species) %>% summarise(median=median(Yield,na.rm=TRUE), q05=quantile(Yield,0.05,na.rm=TRUE), q25=quantile(Yield,0.25,na.rm=TRUE), q75=quantile(Yield,0.75,na.rm=TRUE), q95=quantile(Yield,0.95,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>% mutate(Species=factor(Species, levels=species_order))
  acc_yu <- acc_yu %>% left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by=c("Year","Species")) %>% mutate(has_obs_pos=coalesce(has_obs_pos,FALSE))
  acc_yu_ribbon <- acc_yu %>% filter(!(has_obs_pos==FALSE & (is.na(q95)|q95<=0))) %>% mutate(q05=ifelse(q05>0,q05,NA_real_), q25=ifelse(q25>0,q25,NA_real_), q75=ifelse(q75>0,q75,NA_real_), q95=ifelse(q95>0,q95,NA_real_)) %>% filter(!(is.na(q25)&is.na(q75)&is.na(q05)&is.na(q95)))
  acc_yu_line <- acc_yu %>% filter(!(has_obs_pos==FALSE & (is.na(median)|median<=0))) %>% mutate(median=ifelse(median>0,median,NA_real_))
  yield_obs_filtered_acc <- yield_obs_filtered %>% filter(Species %in% species_with_yield_acc)

  p_acc_biomass <- ggplot() + geom_ribbon(data=acc_bu, aes(x=Year, ymin=q05, ymax=q95, fill=Species), alpha=0.2) + geom_ribbon(data=acc_bu, aes(x=Year, ymin=q25, ymax=q75, fill=Species), alpha=0.3) + geom_line(data=acc_bu, aes(x=Year, y=median, colour=Species), linewidth=1.0) + geom_ribbon(data=obs_biomass_ts, aes(x=Year, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper), alpha=0.2, fill="grey50") + geom_point(data=obs_biomass_ts, aes(x=Year, y=ObsBiomass, colour=Species), size=0.8) + geom_point(data=obs_biomass_ts, aes(x=Year, y=ObsBiomass), shape=1, size=0.8, colour="black") + facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") + scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x) scales::number(x/1e6)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none", strip.text=element_text(face="bold")) + labs(x="Year", y="Biomass [t]", title=paste("Accepted Biomass (", rejection_results$n_accepted, ")", sep=""))
  p_acc_yield <- ggplot() + geom_ribbon(data=acc_yu_ribbon, aes(x=Year, ymin=q05, ymax=q95, fill=Species), alpha=0.2) + geom_ribbon(data=acc_yu_ribbon, aes(x=Year, ymin=q25, ymax=q75, fill=Species), alpha=0.3) + geom_line(data=acc_yu_line, aes(x=Year, y=median, colour=Species), linewidth=1.0, lineend="round") + geom_point(data=yield_obs_filtered_acc, aes(x=Year, y=Yield, colour=Species), size=1) + geom_point(data=yield_obs_filtered_acc, aes(x=Year, y=Yield), shape=1, size=1, colour="black") + geom_vline(xintercept=1961, linetype="dashed") + geom_vline(xintercept=2010, linetype="dashed") + scale_y_log10(breaks=scales::log_breaks(n=6), labels=label_dynamic_decimals) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(start_year,end_year)) + facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none", strip.text=element_text(face="bold")) + labs(x="Year", y="Yield [t/year]", title=paste("Accepted Yield (", rejection_results$n_accepted, ")", sep=""))
  print(p_acc_biomass); print(p_acc_yield)

  # Post-rejection parameter exports
  accepted_param_list <- rejection_results$accepted_parameters; accepted_indices <- rejection_results$accepted_indices
  accepted_params_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(accepted_param_list), function(i){ p<-accepted_param_list[[i]]; if (is.null(p)) return(NULL); data.frame(sim_global_id=accepted_indices[i], sim_accept_rank=i, species=p$species_names, gamma_change=as.numeric(p$gamma_change %||% p$gamma_change_raw), catchability_change=as.numeric(p$catchability_change), abundance_scaling=as.numeric(p$abundance_scaling), stringsAsFactors=FALSE) }))
  if (!is.null(accepted_params_long) && nrow(accepted_params_long)) {
    accepted_param_summary <- accepted_params_long %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(gamma_mean=mean(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), gamma_sd=sd(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), gamma_min=min(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), gamma_max=max(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_mean=mean(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_sd=sd(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_min=min(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_max=max(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), abund_mean=mean(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), abund_sd=sd(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), abund_min=min(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), abund_max=max(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop')
    out_dir <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results"); if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE); ts_stamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    saveRDS(accepted_params_long, file.path(out_dir, paste0("accepted_params_long_", ts_stamp, ".rds")))
    saveRDS(accepted_param_list, file.path(out_dir, paste0("accepted_param_list_", ts_stamp, ".rds")))
    write.csv(accepted_param_summary, file.path(out_dir, paste0("accepted_params_summary_", ts_stamp, ".csv")), row.names=FALSE)
    seed_mean <- accepted_param_summary %>% select(species, gamma_change=gamma_mean, catchability_change=catch_mean, abundance_scaling=abund_mean)
    write.csv(seed_mean, file.path(out_dir, paste0("seed_params_mean_", ts_stamp, ".csv")), row.names=FALSE)
    seed_median <- accepted_params_long %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(gamma_change=median(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), catchability_change=median(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), abundance_scaling=median(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop')
    write.csv(seed_median, file.path(out_dir, paste0("seed_params_median_", ts_stamp, ".csv")), row.names=FALSE)
    set.seed(as.integer(substr(ts_stamp,10,15))); rand_row <- accepted_params_long %>% group_by(species) %>% sample_n(1)
    seed_rand <- rand_row %>% select(species, gamma_change, catchability_change, abundance_scaling)
    write.csv(seed_rand, file.path(out_dir, paste0("seed_params_random_draw_", ts_stamp, ".csv")), row.names=FALSE)
    cat("Seed parameter sets exported (mean, median, random).\n")
  }
}
cat("=== FULL COMBINED MC SECTION COMPLETE ===\n")
```

## Follow-up Monte Carlo Refinement From Seed Parameters

This follow-up analysis uses the selected seed parameter set (mean / median / random) after the full combined Monte Carlo assessment to refine around an accepted region with stricter stability criteria and optional multi-cycle unfished spin-up to further damp residual transients before the historical fishing period.

```{r combined-mc-rerun-from-seed, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
seed_choice <- "mean"   # options: "mean", "median", "random"
seed_prefix_map <- c(mean="seed_params_mean_", median="seed_params_median_", random="seed_params_random_draw_")
seed_prefix <- seed_prefix_map[[seed_choice]]
seed_dir <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results")
seed_files <- list.files(seed_dir, pattern=paste0("^", seed_prefix, ".*\\.csv$"), full.names=TRUE)
if (!length(seed_files)) stop("No seed files found for prefix ", seed_prefix)
seed_file <- seed_files[order(file.info(seed_files)$mtime, decreasing=TRUE)][1]
cat("Using seed file:", basename(seed_file), "\n")
seed_params_df <- read.csv(seed_file, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

if (!exists("params_sel_adj")) {
  if (file.exists("params_sel_adj.rds")) {
    params_sel_adj <- readRDS("params_sel_adj.rds")
  } else stop("Baseline params object 'params_sel_adj' not found.")
}

params_seed <- params_sel_adj
sp_params <- species_params(params_seed)
gp <- gear_params(params_seed)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(seed_params_df))){
  sp <- seed_params_df$species[i]
  idx <- which(sp_params$species==sp)
  if (length(idx)==1){
    gmult <- as.numeric(seed_params_df$gamma_change[i]); if (is.finite(gmult)) sp_params$gamma[idx] <- sp_params$gamma[idx]*gmult
    abund <- as.numeric(seed_params_df$abundance_scaling[i]); if (is.finite(abund)) params_seed@initial_n[idx,] <- params_seed@initial_n[idx,]*abund
  }
  gp_idx <- which(gp$species==sp)
  if (length(gp_idx)==1){ cmult <- as.numeric(seed_params_df$catchability_change[i]); if (is.finite(cmult)) gp$catchability[gp_idx] <- pmin(1, pmax(0, gp$catchability[gp_idx]*cmult)) }
}
species_params(params_seed) <- sp_params; gear_params(params_seed) <- gp

cat("Launching seed-based enhanced MC rerun with checkpointing...\n")

}
```

## Inspect Monte Carlo results (catchability and failure reasons)

```{r rerun-mc-inspect, echo=TRUE}
# If results object is missing but the latest save exists, load it

monte_carlo_results <- rerun_results
# List successful sim IDs (from parameters entries)
success_ids <- if (length(monte_carlo_results$parameters)) sapply(monte_carlo_results$parameters, `[[`, "sim_id") else integer(0)
cat("Successful sim IDs:", if (length(success_ids)) paste(success_ids, collapse=", ") else "<none>", "\n")

# Inspect catchability for the first successful sim (if any)
k <- if (length(monte_carlo_results$parameters)) 1L else NA_integer_
if (!is.na(k)) {
  cabs <- monte_carlo_results$parameters[[k]]$catchability
  if (!is.null(cabs)) {
    # Build labels from baseline gear_params if available
    labs <- NULL
    gp0 <- try(gear_params(params_sel_adj), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(gp0, "try-error") && !is.null(gp0)) {
      if (all(c("species","gear") %in% names(gp0))) {
        labs <- paste0(gp0$species, " / ", gp0$gear)
      } else if (!is.null(rownames(gp0))) {
        labs <- rownames(gp0)
      }
    }
    if (is.null(labs) || length(labs) != length(cabs)) labs <- paste0("row_", seq_along(cabs))

    cat("\nCatchability (absolute) for successful sim_id ", success_ids[k], ":\n", sep="")
    print(setNames(as.numeric(cabs), labs))

    # Also show relative change multiplier if available
    cc <- monte_carlo_results$parameters[[k]]$catchability_change
    if (!is.null(cc)) {
      cat("\nCatchability change (multiplier) vs original:\n")
      if (length(cc) != length(labs)) {
        names(cc) <- paste0("row_", seq_along(cc))
      } else {
        names(cc) <- labs
      }
      print(as.numeric(cc))
    }
  } else {
    cat("No catchability recorded for sim ", success_ids[k], "\n", sep="")
  }
} else {
  cat("No successful simulations to inspect.\n")
}

# Summarize failure reasons (if any)
if (length(monte_carlo_results$failed)) {
  failed_df <- data.frame(
    sim_id = sapply(monte_carlo_results$failed, `[[`, "sim_id"),
    reason = sapply(monte_carlo_results$failed, `[[`, "error"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  cat("\nTop failure reasons (count):\n")
  print(as.data.frame(sort(table(failed_df$reason), decreasing = TRUE)))
  cat("\nFirst few failed entries:\n")
  print(utils::head(failed_df, 10))
} else {
  cat("No failed simulations recorded.\n")
}
```

```{r rerun-montecarlo-assessment, echo=TRUE}
# Function: extract biomass from Monte Carlo sims and combine
extract_monte_carlo_biomass <- function(sim_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
    sim <- sim_list[[i]]
    mat <- getBiomass(sim)
    df <- reshape2::melt(mat)
    names(df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Biomass")
    df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year))
    df$Species <- as.character(df$Species)
    df$sim_id <- i
    df
  }))
}

# Function: extract yield from Monte Carlo sims and combine
extract_monte_carlo_yield <- function(sim_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
    sim <- sim_list[[i]]
    mat <- getYield(sim)
    df <- reshape2::melt(mat)
    names(df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
    df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year))
    df$Species <- as.character(df$Species)
    df$sim_id <- i
    df
  }))
}

# Ensure no negative yields (guard) and identify species with any positive yield

yield_uncertainty <- mc_yield %>%
  filter(Species %in% species_with_yield) %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(Yield, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(Yield, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(Yield, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q05 = quantile(Yield, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    q95 = quantile(Yield, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%

# Build observed positive-yield presence by year/species (proxy for non-zero effort)

  mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Filter modeled zeros only in years without observed positive yield
yield_uncertainty <- yield_uncertainty %>%
  left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by = c("Year", "Species")) %>%
  mutate(has_obs_pos = coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))

# Separate frames for ribbons and line: drop zero-only years when no observed yield
yield_uncertainty_ribbon <- yield_uncertainty %>%
  filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(q95) | q95 <= 0)))

yield_uncertainty_line <- yield_uncertainty %>%
  filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(median) | median <= 0)))

# Prepare log-safe data (log10 requires strictly positive values)
yield_uncertainty_ribbon <- yield_uncertainty_ribbon %>%
  mutate(
    q05 = ifelse(q05 > 0, q05, NA_real_),
    q25 = ifelse(q25 > 0, q25, NA_real_),
    q75 = ifelse(q75 > 0, q75, NA_real_),
    q95 = ifelse(q95 > 0, q95, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(q25) & is.na(q75) & is.na(q05) & is.na(q95)))

yield_uncertainty_line <- yield_uncertainty_line %>%
  mutate(median = ifelse(median > 0, median, NA_real_))

# Filter observed yield data to species present in MC sims (keeps baseline behaviour)

  filter(Species %in% species_with_yield, Yield > 0) %>%
```
