```{r rerun-montecarlo-assessment, echo=TRUE}
  pull(min_year)

  baleen_start_obs
} else if (!is.null(global_start_obs) && length(global_start_obs) == 1 && is.finite(global_start_obs)) {
  global_start_obs
} else { 1930 }
end_year <- max(yield_uncertainty$Year, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot: baseline-style yield with uncertainty ribbons (match baseline line aesthetics)
plot_montecarlo_yield <- function() {
  # Custom label: no decimals for >=1; dynamic decimals for <1 so first non-zero digit shows
  label_dynamic_decimals <- function(x) {
    sci <- scales::label_scientific(digits = 1)
    vapply(x, function(v) {
      if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
      if (v <= 0) return("0")
      vt <- v / 1e6  # convert grams -> tonnes
      if (vt >= 1) {
        paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), " t")
      } else if (vt < 1e-6) {
        paste0(sci(vt), " t")
      } else {
        dp <- max(1, ceiling(-log10(vt)))
        dp <- min(dp, 6)
        paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = dp), " t")
      }
    }, character(1))
  }
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = yield_uncertainty_line, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species),
        linewidth = 1.0, linetype = "solid", lineend = "round") +
    geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield, colour = .data$Species), size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield), shape = 1, size = 1, colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1961, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2010, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 6), labels = label_dynamic_decimals) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(start_year, end_year)) +
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Yield [t/year]", title = paste("Monte Carlo: Yield vs Observations (", length(valid_sims), " sims)"))
}
```

## Visualize Enhanced Uncertainty Analysis Results

## Parameter Optimization Using Yield Time Series (Prototype)

```{r combine-rerun-seed-results, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
# Combine rerun seed Monte Carlo result files (seed_rerun_results_*.rds) into a single object.
# Placed immediately before optimization so that aggregated rerun parameter distributions (e.g., abundance_scaling)
# can inform optimization bounds.

combine_rerun_successful_sims <- function(
  rerun_dir = file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results","rerun_results"),
  pattern = "^seed_rerun_results_.*\\.rds$",
  out_basename = paste0("combined_rerun_successful_sims_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")),
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(tibble) })
  `%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
  if (!dir.exists(rerun_dir)) stop("Rerun directory not found: ", rerun_dir)
  files <- list.files(rerun_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  if (!length(files)) stop("No rerun result files found in ", rerun_dir)
  if (verbose) cat("Found", length(files), "rerun result files.\n")

  all_sims <- list(); all_params <- list(); sim_keys <- character()
  make_run_id <- function(obj, fname){
    if (!is.null(obj$settings) && is.list(obj$settings)) {
      s <- obj$settings
      paste0(
        "seed=", s$seed_choice %||% NA,
        ";nsims=", s$total_sims %||% NA,
        ";sd=", s$catchability_sd %||% NA, "_", s$abundance_sd %||% NA, "_", s$gamma_sd %||% NA,
        ";tol=", s$enhanced_steady_tol %||% NA,
        ";tmax=", s$enhanced_steady_t_max %||% NA
      )
    } else basename(fname)
  }

  for (f in files) {
    obj <- try(readRDS(f), silent=TRUE)
    if (inherits(obj, "try-error")) { if (verbose) cat("Skipping unreadable:", f, "\n"); next }
    if (!is.list(obj) || is.null(obj$simulations) || is.null(obj$parameters)) { if (verbose) cat("Skipping non-results object:", f, "\n"); next }
    sims <- obj$simulations; params <- obj$parameters
    if (!length(sims) || !length(params)) next
    run_id <- make_run_id(obj, f)
    for (i in seq_along(sims)) {
      s <- sims[[i]]; p <- params[[i]]; if (is.null(s)||is.null(p)) next
      key <- paste0(run_id, "::", (p$sim_id %||% i))
      all_sims[[length(all_sims)+1L]] <- s
      all_params[[length(all_params)+1L]] <- c(p, list(run_id=run_id, source_file=f, sim_key=key))
      sim_keys[length(sim_keys)+1L] <- key
    }
  }
  if (!length(all_sims)) stop("No valid simulations aggregated from rerun files.")

  param_tbl <- tibble(
    sim_key = sim_keys,
    run_id = sapply(all_params, `[[`, "run_id"),
    source_file = sapply(all_params, `[[`, "source_file"),
    sim_id_within_file = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$sim_id %||% NA_integer_),
    species_names = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "species_names"),
    abundance_scaling = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "abundance_scaling"),
    gamma_change = lapply(all_params, function(x) x$gamma_change %||% x$gamma_change_raw %||% NA),
    catchability_change = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "catchability_change"),
    catchability = lapply(all_params, `[[`, "catchability"),
    stable = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$stable %||% NA),
    max_cv = sapply(all_params, function(x) x$max_cv %||% NA_real_)
  )
  flat_summary <- param_tbl %>%
    transmute(sim_key, run_id, source_file, sim_id_within_file, stable, max_cv,
              n_species = vapply(species_names, length, integer(1)),
              mean_gamma_mult = vapply(gamma_change, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm=TRUE), numeric(1)),
              mean_abund_mult = vapply(abundance_scaling, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm=TRUE), numeric(1)),
              mean_catchability = vapply(catchability, function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else mean(as.numeric(v), na.rm=TRUE), numeric(1)))

  out_rds <- file.path(rerun_dir, paste0(out_basename, ".rds"))
  out_csv <- file.path(rerun_dir, paste0("combined_rerun_params_summary_", substr(out_basename, nchar("combined_rerun_successful_sims_")+1, 999), ".csv"))

  combined <- list(
    simulations = all_sims,
    parameters = all_params,
    parameters_table = param_tbl,
    flat_summary = flat_summary,
    n_successful = length(all_sims),
    n_attempts = length(all_sims),
    failed = list(),
    settings = list(combined_from = files, combined_at = Sys.time(), type="rerun_combined"),
    created = Sys.time()
  )
  saveRDS(combined, out_rds)
  utils::write.csv(flat_summary, out_csv, row.names=FALSE)
  if (verbose) cat("Saved combined rerun sims:\n - RDS:", out_rds, "\n - CSV:", out_csv, "\nTotal sims:", length(all_sims), "\n")
  invisible(combined)
}

# Execute combination (set eval=TRUE after inspection when ready)
rerun_combined_success <- combine_rerun_successful_sims()
# Provide alias for optimization chunk expecting rerun_results
if (!exists("rerun_results")) rerun_results <- rerun_combined_success
```

```{r rerun-combined-montecarlo-assessment, echo=TRUE}
# Function: extract biomass from Monte Carlo sims and combine
extract_monte_carlo_biomass <- function(sim_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
    sim <- sim_list[[i]]
    mat <- getBiomass(sim)
    df <- reshape2::melt(mat)
    names(df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Biomass")
    df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year))
    df$Species <- as.character(df$Species)
    df$sim_id <- i
    df
  }))
}

# Function: extract yield from Monte Carlo sims and combine
extract_monte_carlo_yield <- function(sim_list) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(i) {
    sim <- sim_list[[i]]
    mat <- getYield(sim)
    df <- reshape2::melt(mat)
    names(df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
    df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Year))
    df$Species <- as.character(df$Species)
    df$sim_id <- i
    df
  }))
}

# Prepare combined MC biomass and compute uncertainty intervals
mc_biomass <- extract_monte_carlo_biomass(valid_sims)
biomass_uncertainty <- mc_biomass %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(Biomass, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(Biomass, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q05 = quantile(Biomass, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    q95 = quantile(Biomass, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

# Build observation timeseries for plotting (use species-specific bounds)

  obs_biomass_data %>%
    left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% select(Species, Lower = Lower_g, Upper = Upper_g), by = "Species") %>%
  tidyr::crossing(Year = 2000:2010) %>%
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))
)

## (removed duplicate early biomass plot; using the updated version below)

# Prepare combined MC yield and compute uncertainty
mc_yield <- extract_monte_carlo_yield(valid_sims)
# Ensure no negative yields (guard) and identify species with any positive yield
mc_yield <- mc_yield %>% mutate(Yield = pmax(Yield, 0))
species_with_yield <- mc_yield %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarise(max_yield = max(Yield, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>% filter(max_yield > 0) %>% pull(Species)
cat("Monte Carlo: species with fishing yields:", paste(species_with_yield, collapse = ", "), "\n")

yield_uncertainty <- mc_yield %>%
  filter(Species %in% species_with_yield) %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(Yield, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(Yield, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(Yield, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q05 = quantile(Yield, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    q95 = quantile(Yield, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

# Build observed positive-yield presence by year/species (proxy for non-zero effort)
obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
  mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Filter modeled zeros only in years without observed positive yield
yield_uncertainty <- yield_uncertainty %>%
  left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by = c("Year", "Species")) %>%
  mutate(has_obs_pos = coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))

# Separate frames for ribbons and line: drop zero-only years when no observed yield
yield_uncertainty_ribbon <- yield_uncertainty %>%
  filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(q95) | q95 <= 0)))

yield_uncertainty_line <- yield_uncertainty %>%
  filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(median) | median <= 0)))

# Prepare log-safe data (log10 requires strictly positive values)
yield_uncertainty_ribbon <- yield_uncertainty_ribbon %>%
  mutate(
    q05 = ifelse(q05 > 0, q05, NA_real_),
    q25 = ifelse(q25 > 0, q25, NA_real_),
    q75 = ifelse(q75 > 0, q75, NA_real_),
    q95 = ifelse(q95 > 0, q95, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(q25) & is.na(q75) & is.na(q05) & is.na(q95)))

yield_uncertainty_line <- yield_uncertainty_line %>%
  mutate(median = ifelse(median > 0, median, NA_real_))

# Filter observed yield data to species present in MC sims (keeps baseline behaviour)
yield_obs_filtered <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
  filter(Species %in% species_with_yield, Yield > 0) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

# Determine plotting x-range based on observed non-zero yields (proxy for effort)
# Prefer baleen whales start year; fallback to earliest observed non-zero across species; then 1930
baleen_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>%
  filter(Species == "baleen whales") %>%
  summarise(min_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(min_year)
global_start_obs <- yield_obs_filtered %>% summarise(min_year = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(min_year)
start_year <- if (!is.null(baleen_start_obs) && length(baleen_start_obs) == 1 && is.finite(baleen_start_obs)) {
  baleen_start_obs
} else if (!is.null(global_start_obs) && length(global_start_obs) == 1 && is.finite(global_start_obs)) {
  global_start_obs
} else { 1930 }
end_year <- max(yield_uncertainty$Year, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot: baseline-style yield with uncertainty ribbons (match baseline line aesthetics)
plot_montecarlo_yield <- function() {
  # Custom label: no decimals for >=1; dynamic decimals for <1 so first non-zero digit shows
  label_dynamic_decimals <- function(x) {
    sci <- scales::label_scientific(digits = 1)
    vapply(x, function(v) {
      if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
      if (v <= 0) return("0")
      vt <- v / 1e6  # convert grams -> tonnes
      if (vt >= 1) {
        paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","), " t")
      } else if (vt < 1e-6) {
        paste0(sci(vt), " t")
      } else {
        dp <- max(1, ceiling(-log10(vt)))
        dp <- min(dp, 6)
        paste0(formatC(vt, format = "f", digits = dp), " t")
      }
    }, character(1))
  }
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = yield_uncertainty_ribbon, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = yield_uncertainty_line, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species),
        linewidth = 1.0, linetype = "solid", lineend = "round") +
    geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield, colour = .data$Species), size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = yield_obs_filtered, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$Yield), shape = 1, size = 1, colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1961, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2010, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 6), labels = label_dynamic_decimals) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(start_year, end_year)) +
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Yield [t/year]", title = paste("Monte Carlo: Yield vs Observations (", length(valid_sims), " sims)"))
}

# Update biomass plot to display tonnes on the y-axis and include units
plot_montecarlo_biomass <- function() {
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_uncertainty,
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q05, ymax = .data$q95, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = biomass_uncertainty,
                aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$q25, ymax = .data$q75, fill = .data$Species), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(data = biomass_uncertainty,
              aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$median, color = .data$Species), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data = obs_biomass_ts, aes(x = .data$Year, ymin = .data$Lower, ymax = .data$Upper), alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray50") +
    geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass, color = .data$Species), size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = obs_biomass_ts, aes(x = .data$Year, y = .data$ObsBiomass), shape = 1, size = 0.8, colour = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::number(x/1e6)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Biomass [t]", title = paste("Monte Carlo: Biomass vs Observations (", length(valid_sims), " sims)"))
}
```

```{r rerun-combined-montecarlo-assessment-full, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_parameter_distributions <- function(param_list, param_type = c("catchability","abundance"), title_suffix=""){
  param_type <- match.arg(param_type); extractor <- if (param_type=="catchability") "catchability_change" else "abundance_scaling"
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_list), function(i){ p<-param_list[[i]]; v<-p[[extractor]]; sp<-p$species_names; if (is.null(v)||is.null(sp)) return(NULL); data.frame(sim_id=i, species=sp, value=as.numeric(v)) }))
  if (is.null(df)||!nrow(df)) return(ggplot()+labs(title=paste(param_type,"distribution",title_suffix), subtitle="No data"))
  ggplot(df, aes(x=value)) + geom_histogram(bins=40, fill="steelblue", colour="black", alpha=0.7) + facet_wrap(~species, scales="free_y") + theme_bw() + theme(strip.text=element_text(size=7, face="bold")) + labs(title=paste(param_type, "distribution", title_suffix), x=param_type, y="Frequency")
}

plot_gamma_distribution_fixed <- function(param_combinations, title_suffix = "") {
  gamma_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_combinations), function(i){ p<-param_combinations[[i]]; if (is.null(p)) return(NULL); val <- if (!is.null(p$gamma_change_raw)) p$gamma_change_raw else p$gamma_change; if (is.null(val)) return(NULL); data.frame(sim_id=i, species=p$species_names, gamma_change=val) }))
  if (is.null(gamma_data)||!nrow(gamma_data)) return(ggplot()+labs(title=paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle="No data"))
  gamma_data <- gamma_data %>% filter(is.finite(gamma_change), gamma_change>0) %>% mutate(log10_gamma=log10(gamma_change))
  if (!nrow(gamma_data)) return(ggplot()+labs(title=paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), subtitle="No positive values"))
  rng <- quantile(gamma_data$log10_gamma, c(0.01,0.99), na.rm=TRUE); if (!all(is.finite(rng))||diff(rng)==0) rng <- range(gamma_data$log10_gamma)
  pad <- max(0.05, diff(rng)*0.05); xmin <- floor(rng[1]-pad); xmax <- ceiling(rng[2]+pad); bw <- max(0.05,(xmax-xmin)/60); breaks <- seq(floor(xmin), ceiling(xmax))
  ggplot(gamma_data, aes(x=log10_gamma)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=bw, fill="steelblue", alpha=0.7, colour="black") + facet_wrap(~species, scales="free_y") + scale_x_continuous(breaks=breaks, labels=function(x) scales::math_format(10^.x)(x)) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(xmin,xmax)) + theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=7), strip.text=element_text(size=7,face="bold")) + labs(title=paste("Gamma Parameter Distribution", title_suffix), x="Gamma Change Factor (log10)", y="Frequency") + geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", colour="red", alpha=0.8, linewidth=0.6)
}

apply_biomass_rejection_criteria <- function(sim_results, param_combinations, obs_biomass_data, tolerance=0.5, comparison_years=2000:2010, verbose=TRUE, allow_outside=3, obs_bounds_table=NULL){
  if (!is.null(obs_bounds_table)) { obs_bounds <- obs_bounds_table %>% transmute(Species, lower_bound=Lower_g, upper_bound=Upper_g) } else { obs_bounds <- obs_biomass_bounds %>% transmute(Species, lower_bound=Lower_g, upper_bound=Upper_g) }
  lower_by <- setNames(obs_bounds$lower_bound, obs_bounds$Species); upper_by <- setNames(obs_bounds$upper_bound, obs_bounds$Species)
  accepted_idx <- integer(0); details <- vector("list", length(sim_results))
  for (i in seq_along(sim_results)) { sim <- sim_results[[i]]; if (is.null(sim)||!inherits(sim,"MizerSim")) next; bm <- getBiomass(sim); yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(bm)); sel <- yrs %in% comparison_years; if (!any(sel)) next; mean_bm <- colMeans(bm[sel,,drop=FALSE]); sp <- names(mean_bm); within <- vapply(sp, function(spp){ if (spp %in% names(lower_by)) { mb<-mean_bm[[spp]]; lo<-lower_by[[spp]]; hi<-upper_by[[spp]]; is.finite(mb)&&mb>=lo&&mb<=hi } else TRUE }, logical(1)); failures <- sum(!within[sp %in% names(lower_by)], na.rm=TRUE); ok <- failures <= allow_outside; if (ok) accepted_idx <- c(accepted_idx,i); details[[i]] <- list(accepted=ok, n_failures=failures) }
  list(accepted_indices=accepted_idx, accepted_simulations=sim_results[accepted_idx], accepted_parameters=param_combinations[accepted_idx], n_accepted=length(accepted_idx), acceptance_rate=length(accepted_idx)/max(1,length(sim_results)), rejection_details=details)
}

  print(p_acc_biomass); print(p_acc_yield)

  accepted_param_list <- rejection_results$accepted_parameters; accepted_indices <- rejection_results$accepted_indices
  accepted_params_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(accepted_param_list), function(i){ p<-accepted_param_list[[i]]; if (is.null(p)) return(NULL); data.frame(sim_global_id=accepted_indices[i], sim_accept_rank=i, species=p$species_names, gamma_change=as.numeric(p$gamma_change %||% p$gamma_change_raw), catchability_change=as.numeric(p$catchability_change), abundance_scaling=as.numeric(p$abundance_scaling), stringsAsFactors=FALSE) }))
  if (!is.null(accepted_params_long) && nrow(accepted_params_long)) {
    accepted_param_summary <- accepted_params_long %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(gamma_mean=mean(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), gamma_sd=sd(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), gamma_min=min(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), gamma_max=max(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_mean=mean(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_sd=sd(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_min=min(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), catch_max=max(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), abund_mean=mean(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), abund_sd=sd(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), abund_min=min(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), abund_max=max(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop')
    out_dir <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results"); if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE)
    ts_stamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    # Provide a run label to distinguish this second rerun from prior exports
    run_label <- "combined_rerun2"
    # Derive an incremental index (counts existing accepted_params_long files containing run_label)
    existing <- list.files(out_dir, pattern=paste0("accepted_params_long_", run_label), full.names=FALSE)
    run_index <- if (length(existing)) sprintf("%02d", length(existing)+1) else "01"
    base_tag <- paste0(run_label, "_", run_index, "_", ts_stamp)
    # Helper to avoid accidental collision (unlikely unless run multiple times in <1s)
    uniquify <- function(path){ if (!file.exists(path)) return(path); paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(path), "_dup", sample(1000:9999,1), ".", tools::file_ext(path)) }
    saveRDS(accepted_params_long, uniquify(file.path(out_dir, paste0("accepted_params_long_", base_tag, ".rds"))))
    saveRDS(accepted_param_list, uniquify(file.path(out_dir, paste0("accepted_param_list_", base_tag, ".rds"))))
    write.csv(accepted_param_summary, uniquify(file.path(out_dir, paste0("accepted_params_summary_", base_tag, ".csv"))), row.names=FALSE)
    seed_mean <- accepted_param_summary %>% select(species, gamma_change=gamma_mean, catchability_change=catch_mean, abundance_scaling=abund_mean)
    write.csv(seed_mean, uniquify(file.path(out_dir, paste0("seed_params_mean_", base_tag, ".csv"))), row.names=FALSE)
    seed_median <- accepted_params_long %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(gamma_change=median(gamma_change,na.rm=TRUE), catchability_change=median(catchability_change,na.rm=TRUE), abundance_scaling=median(abundance_scaling,na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop')
    write.csv(seed_median, uniquify(file.path(out_dir, paste0("seed_params_median_", base_tag, ".csv"))), row.names=FALSE)
    set.seed(as.integer(substr(ts_stamp,10,15)))
    rand_row <- accepted_params_long %>% group_by(species) %>% slice_sample(n=1)
    seed_rand <- rand_row %>% select(species, gamma_change, catchability_change, abundance_scaling)
    write.csv(seed_rand, uniquify(file.path(out_dir, paste0("seed_params_random_draw_", base_tag, ".csv"))), row.names=FALSE)
    cat("Seed parameter sets exported (mean, median, random) with run label '", run_label, "' and index ", run_index, "\n", sep="")
  } else {
    cat("No accepted parameters to export in this rerun.\n")
  }
```

## Select Best Model Based on Yield Fit Metrics

```{r select-best-model, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Select the best simulation from accepted results based on correlation and normalized RMSE
# between modeled and observed yields

if (exists("rejection_results") && rejection_results$n_accepted > 0) {
  
  # Extract accepted simulations and parameters
  accepted_sims <- rejection_results$accepted_simulations
  accepted_params <- rejection_results$accepted_parameters
  
  # Function to calculate yield fit metrics for a single simulation
  calculate_yield_metrics <- function(sim, obs_data = yield_ts_tidy) {
    # Extract yield from simulation
    yield_mat <- getYield(sim)
    yield_df <- reshape2::melt(yield_mat)
    names(yield_df) <- c("Year", "Species", "Yield")
    yield_df$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(yield_df$Year))
    yield_df$Species <- as.character(yield_df$Species)
    
    # Join with observed data
    obs_sub <- obs_data %>% 
      dplyr::filter(Yield > 0) %>%  # Only compare years with observed positive yield
      dplyr::select(Year, Species, Obs_Yield = Yield)
    
    combined <- yield_df %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(obs_sub, by = c("Year", "Species")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(Yield), is.finite(Obs_Yield), 
                   Yield > 0, Obs_Yield > 0)  # Ensure positive values for log transform
    
    if (nrow(combined) == 0) {
      return(list(correlation = NA, nrmse = NA, n_points = 0))
    }
    
    # Log-transform yields for better comparison (as used in optimization)
    log_modeled <- log10(combined$Yield + 1)
    log_observed <- log10(combined$Obs_Yield + 1)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    correlation <- cor(log_modeled, log_observed, use = "complete.obs")
    
    # Calculate normalized RMSE
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((log_modeled - log_observed)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    mean_obs <- mean(log_observed, na.rm = TRUE)
    nrmse <- rmse / mean_obs  # Normalized by mean of observed
    
    return(list(
      correlation = correlation,
      nrmse = nrmse,
      n_points = nrow(combined),
      rmse = rmse
    ))
  }
  
  cat("Calculating yield fit metrics for", length(accepted_sims), "accepted simulations...\n")
  
  # Calculate metrics for all accepted simulations
  metrics_list <- lapply(seq_along(accepted_sims), function(i) {
    metrics <- calculate_yield_metrics(accepted_sims[[i]])
    metrics$sim_index <- i
    metrics$global_index <- rejection_results$accepted_indices[i]
    return(metrics)
  })
  
  # Convert to data frame
  metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(metrics_list, function(x) {
    data.frame(
      sim_index = x$sim_index,
      global_index = x$global_index,
      correlation = x$correlation,
      nrmse = x$nrmse,
      rmse = x$rmse,
      n_points = x$n_points,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  # Remove simulations with insufficient data or invalid metrics
  valid_metrics <- metrics_df[is.finite(metrics_df$correlation) & 
                             is.finite(metrics_df$nrmse) & 
                             metrics_df$n_points >= 10, ]  # Require at least 10 comparison points
  
  if (nrow(valid_metrics) > 0) {
    
    # Create composite score: high correlation (good) + low NRMSE (good)
    # Normalize metrics to 0-1 scale for combining
    valid_metrics$corr_norm <- (valid_metrics$correlation - min(valid_metrics$correlation, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                              (max(valid_metrics$correlation, na.rm = TRUE) - min(valid_metrics$correlation, na.rm = TRUE))
    valid_metrics$nrmse_norm <- 1 - ((valid_metrics$nrmse - min(valid_metrics$nrmse, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                                    (max(valid_metrics$nrmse, na.rm = TRUE) - min(valid_metrics$nrmse, na.rm = TRUE)))
    
    # Composite score (equal weighting of correlation and inverse NRMSE)
    valid_metrics$composite_score <- 0.5 * valid_metrics$corr_norm + 0.5 * valid_metrics$nrmse_norm
    
    # Sort by composite score (descending - higher is better)
    valid_metrics <- valid_metrics[order(valid_metrics$composite_score, decreasing = TRUE), ]
    
    # Select best simulation
    best_idx <- valid_metrics$sim_index[1]
    best_sim <- accepted_sims[[best_idx]]
    best_params <- accepted_params[[best_idx]]
    
    cat("\n=== BEST MODEL SELECTION RESULTS ===\n")
    cat("Total accepted simulations:", nrow(metrics_df), "\n")
    cat("Simulations with valid metrics:", nrow(valid_metrics), "\n")
    cat("Best simulation index (within accepted):", best_idx, "\n")
    cat("Best simulation global index:", valid_metrics$global_index[1], "\n")
    cat("Best correlation:", round(valid_metrics$correlation[1], 4), "\n")
    cat("Best normalized RMSE:", round(valid_metrics$nrmse[1], 4), "\n")
    cat("Best composite score:", round(valid_metrics$composite_score[1], 4), "\n")
    cat("Comparison points:", valid_metrics$n_points[1], "\n")
    
    # Show top 5 candidates
    cat("\nTop 5 candidates:\n")
    top5 <- head(valid_metrics, 5)
    for (i in 1:nrow(top5)) {
      cat("Rank", i, ": Sim", top5$sim_index[i], 
          "| Corr:", round(top5$correlation[i], 3),
          "| NRMSE:", round(top5$nrmse[i], 3),
          "| Score:", round(top5$composite_score[i], 3), "\n")
    }
    
    # Save best model and metrics
    best_model_results <- list(
      simulation = best_sim,
      parameters = best_params,
      metrics = valid_metrics[1, ],
      all_metrics = valid_metrics,
      selection_criteria = "composite_score_corr_nrmse"
    )
    
    # Save to file
    saveRDS(best_model_results, "best_model_yield_fit.rds")
    cat("\nBest model saved to: best_model_yield_fit.rds\n")
    
    # ---- Create tunable parameter object from best simulation ----
    cat("\n=== CREATING TUNABLE PARAMETER OBJECT ===\n")
    
    # Start with baseline parameters
    if (!exists("params_sel_adj")) {
      if (file.exists("params_sel_adj.rds")) {
        params_sel_adj <- readRDS("params_sel_adj.rds")
      } else {
        stop("Baseline params object 'params_sel_adj' not found.")
      }
    }
    
    # Create a copy for modification
    params_best <- params_sel_adj
    
    # Apply the best parameter changes
    if (!is.null(best_params) && length(best_params) > 0) {
      
      # Get species and gear parameter tables
      sp_params <- species_params(params_best)
      gp_params <- gear_params(params_best)
      
      # Extract parameter changes from best_params
      species_names <- best_params$species_names
      gamma_changes <- as.numeric(best_params$gamma_change)
      catchability_changes <- as.numeric(best_params$catchability_change)
      abundance_changes <- as.numeric(best_params$abundance_scaling)
      
      # Apply gamma changes
      if (!is.null(gamma_changes) && length(gamma_changes) == length(species_names)) {
        for (i in seq_along(species_names)) {
          sp <- species_names[i]
          idx <- which(sp_params$species == sp)
          if (length(idx) == 1 && is.finite(gamma_changes[i])) {
            original_gamma <- sp_params$gamma[idx]
            new_gamma <- original_gamma * gamma_changes[i]
            sp_params$gamma[idx] <- new_gamma
            cat("Species:", sp, "| Gamma:", round(original_gamma, 6), "->", round(new_gamma, 6), 
                "(x", round(gamma_changes[i], 3), ")\n")
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Apply catchability changes
      if (!is.null(catchability_changes) && length(catchability_changes) == length(species_names)) {
        for (i in seq_along(species_names)) {
          sp <- species_names[i]
          gp_idx <- which(gp_params$species == sp)
          if (length(gp_idx) == 1 && is.finite(catchability_changes[i])) {
            original_catch <- gp_params$catchability[gp_idx]
            new_catch <- pmin(1, pmax(0, original_catch * catchability_changes[i]))
            gp_params$catchability[gp_idx] <- new_catch
            cat("Species:", sp, "| Catchability:", round(original_catch, 6), "->", round(new_catch, 6), 
                "(x", round(catchability_changes[i], 3), ")\n")
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Apply abundance scaling changes
      if (!is.null(abundance_changes) && length(abundance_changes) == length(species_names)) {
        for (i in seq_along(species_names)) {
          sp <- species_names[i]
          idx <- which(sp_params$species == sp)
          if (length(idx) == 1 && is.finite(abundance_changes[i])) {
            # Scale the initial abundance matrix for this species
            params_best@initial_n[idx, ] <- params_best@initial_n[idx, ] * abundance_changes[i]
            cat("Species:", sp, "| Abundance scaling:", round(abundance_changes[i], 3), "\n")
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Update the parameter object with modified tables
      species_params(params_best) <- sp_params
      gear_params(params_best) <- gp_params
      
      cat("\nParameter object 'params_best' created with best simulation parameters.\n")
      cat("Use this object for manual parameter tuning and single simulations.\n")
      
      # Save the tunable parameter object
      saveRDS(params_best, "params_best_tunable.rds")
      cat("Tunable parameters saved to: params_best_tunable.rds\n")
      
      # Create a summary of the applied changes
      param_summary <- data.frame(
        Species = species_names,
        Gamma_Multiplier = if(!is.null(gamma_changes)) gamma_changes else NA,
        Catchability_Multiplier = if(!is.null(catchability_changes)) catchability_changes else NA,
        Abundance_Multiplier = if(!is.null(abundance_changes)) abundance_changes else NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      # Save parameter summary
      write.csv(param_summary, "best_model_parameter_changes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
      cat("Parameter changes summary saved to: best_model_parameter_changes.csv\n")
      
      # Print quick usage example
      cat("\n=== USAGE EXAMPLE ===\n")
      cat("# Load the tunable parameters:\n")
      cat("params_best <- readRDS('params_best_tunable.rds')\n\n")
      cat("# Run a single simulation:\n")
      cat("sim <- project(params_best, effort = combined_effort_array, t_start = 1841, t_max = 170)\n\n")
      cat("# Or with steady state first:\n")
      cat("params_steady <- steady(params_best, t_max = 200)\n")
      cat("sim <- project(params_steady, effort = combined_effort_array, t_start = 1841, t_max = 170)\n\n")
      cat("# Manual parameter tuning examples:\n")
      cat("# Adjust gamma for a specific species:\n")
      cat("sp_params <- species_params(params_best)\n")
      cat("sp_params$gamma[sp_params$species == 'baleen whales'] <- 0.5  # Example value\n")
      cat("species_params(params_best) <- sp_params\n\n")
      cat("# Adjust catchability:\n")
      cat("gp_params <- gear_params(params_best)\n")
      cat("gp_params$catchability[gp_params$species == 'baleen whales'] <- 0.3  # Example value\n")
      cat("gear_params(params_best) <- gp_params\n")
      
    } else {
      cat("Warning: No parameter data found in best simulation results.\n")
      params_best <- params_sel_adj  # Fallback to baseline
    }
    
    # Optional: create a simple plot showing the distribution of metrics
    if (require(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)) {
      p_metrics <- ggplot(valid_metrics, aes(x = correlation, y = nrmse)) +
        geom_point(aes(color = composite_score), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_point(data = valid_metrics[1, ], color = "red", size = 4, shape = 1, stroke = 2) +
        scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Composite\nScore") +
        labs(title = "Yield Fit Metrics for Accepted Simulations",
             subtitle = "Red circle = selected best model",
             x = "Correlation (log10 yields)",
             y = "Normalized RMSE") +
        theme_bw()
      
      print(p_metrics)
      ggsave("best_model_selection_metrics.png", p_metrics, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
      cat("Metrics plot saved to: best_model_selection_metrics.png\n")
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("No simulations with valid yield fit metrics found.\n")
    best_model_results <- NULL
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No accepted simulations available for best model selection.\n")
  best_model_results <- NULL
}
```

```{r rerun-combined-mc-rerun-from-seed, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
seed_choice <- "mean"   # options: "mean", "median", "random"
seed_prefix_map <- c(mean="seed_params_mean_", median="seed_params_median_", random="seed_params_random_draw_")
```

```{r optimize-params-yield, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
                       q90 = pmax(abundance_scaling * (1 + expand_frac), abundance_scaling * 1.05))
    if (!nrow(abundance_info)) abundance_info <- NULL else message("Abundance bounds derived from summary seed means (±", expand_frac*100, "%).")

}

# Helper to apply parameter vector to a copy of params
apply_param_vector <- function(p_obj, par_vec){
  # Structure: catch (nf) + gamma (all species) + [abundance (all species)]
  base_len <- if (species_gamma) nf + na_full else nf + 1
  expected <- if (include_abundance_scaling) base_len + na_full else base_len
  stopifnot(length(par_vec) == expected)
  gp <- gear_params(p_obj); sp <- species_params(p_obj)
  # Segments
  catch_logs <- par_vec[1:nf]
  if (species_gamma) {
    gamma_logs <- par_vec[(nf+1):(nf+na_full)]
    offset <- nf + na_full
  } else {
    gamma_logs <- rep(par_vec[nf+1], na_full)
    offset <- nf + 1
  }
  if (include_abundance_scaling) abundance_logs <- par_vec[(offset+1):(offset+na_full)] else abundance_logs <- rep(0, na_full)
  catch_mult <- exp(catch_logs); gamma_mult <- exp(gamma_logs); abundance_mult <- exp(abundance_logs)
  # Apply catchability to fished species only
  for (i in seq_len(nf)) {
    s <- fished_species[i]
    idx_g <- which(gp$species == s)
    if (length(idx_g)==1) gp$catchability[idx_g] <- pmin(1, pmax(1e-6, gp$catchability[idx_g] * catch_mult[i]))
  }
  # Apply gamma to all species
  for (i in seq_len(na_full)) {
    s <- all_species_full[i]; idx_sp <- which(sp$species == s)
    if (length(idx_sp)==1 && "gamma" %in% colnames(sp)) sp$gamma[idx_sp] <- pmax(1e-6, sp$gamma[idx_sp] * gamma_mult[i])
  }
  species_params(p_obj) <- sp; gear_params(p_obj) <- gp
  # Abundance scaling
  if (include_abundance_scaling) {
    init_n <- NULL; init_ok <- FALSE
    for (slot_name in c("initial_n","initialN","n0")) {
      if (!init_ok) { val <- try(slot(p_obj, slot_name), silent=TRUE); if (!inherits(val,"try-error") && !is.null(val)) { init_n <- val; init_ok <- TRUE } }
    }
    if (init_ok && !is.null(init_n)) {
      for (i in seq_len(na_full)) {
        s <- all_species_full[i]; if (s %in% rownames(init_n)) init_n[s,] <- init_n[s,] * abundance_mult[i]
      }
      try({slot(p_obj, "initial_n") <- init_n}, silent=TRUE)
    }
  }
  p_obj
}

# Ensure an initial_n matrix is compatible with the given params object.
# Returns a reordered matrix or NULL if it cannot be made compatible.
sanitize_initial_n <- function(p_obj, n_mat){
  if (is.null(n_mat)) return(NULL)
  if (length(n_mat) == 0) return(NULL)
  # Must be a 2D matrix with species rows and size columns
  if (!is.matrix(n_mat)) {
    # Try to coerce only if dim attributes present
    dm <- dim(n_mat)
    if (length(dm) == 2) {
      n_mat <- matrix(n_mat, nrow = dm[1], ncol = dm[2])
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  sp <- try(species_params(p_obj), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(sp, "try-error") || is.null(sp)) return(NULL)
  sp_order <- sp$species
  if (is.null(rownames(n_mat)) || is.null(colnames(n_mat))) return(NULL)
  # Align species order; require all species present
  if (!all(sp_order %in% rownames(n_mat))) return(NULL)
  n_mat <- n_mat[sp_order, , drop=FALSE]
  # Check column alignment by count using existing initial_n as reference when available
  init_n_ref <- try(slot(p_obj, "initial_n"), silent=TRUE)
  if (!inherits(init_n_ref, "try-error") && !is.null(init_n_ref)) {
    if (ncol(n_mat) != ncol(init_n_ref)) return(NULL)
  }
  n_mat
}

# Objective: mean squared error of log10(1 + yield_tonnes) across species & years
steady_screen_enable <- TRUE            # run steady() pre screen
steady_tmax_opt <- 250                  # steady() t_max
spinup_screen_enable <- TRUE            # perform unfished spin-up
spinup_years_opt <- 118                 # unfished spin-up years (historical warm-up)
# (Legacy single-window quick checks retained but replaced by multi-cycle enhanced stability logic below)
stability_window <- 5                   # legacy short-window size (still used if fallback triggered)
stability_rel_change_max <- 0.3         # legacy relative change threshold
stability_cv_max <- 0.35                # legacy CV threshold
opt_spinup_cycles <- 3                  # enhanced: number of sequential unfished spin-up cycles
opt_spinup_early_exit <- TRUE           # allow early exit if stable before max cycles
opt_spinup_min_cycles <- 2              # require at least this many cycles before early exit
opt_override_stability <- TRUE          # use tighter thresholds for optimization (independent of MC analysis)
opt_stability_cv_threshold <- 0.08      # tighter CV (8%) for optimizer spin-up
opt_stability_trend_rel_slope_max <- 0.01  # tighter trend (1% per year)

# Biomass decline penalty settings (projection robustness)
decline_penalty_enable <- TRUE
decline_species_mode <- "sentinel"     # 'sentinel' or 'fished'
sentinel_decline_species <- c("minke whales","leopard seals")
decline_threshold <- 0.5               # penalize if end biomass < 50% of early biomass
``` 
