```{r optimize-params-yield, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
decline_window_mean <- 5               # number of early/late match years to average
extinction_threshold <- 1e-6            # biomass extinction threshold (grams)
protect_non_fished <- TRUE              # penalize non-fished crashes
non_fished_species <- setdiff(all_species_full, fished_species)

# Optional: load constant climate forcing arrays (not directly injected here without full interface context)
if (!exists("const_n_pp") && file.exists("constant_array_n_pp_1841.RDS")) {
  const_n_pp <- try(readRDS("constant_array_n_pp_1841.RDS"), silent=TRUE)
}
if (!exists("const_temp") && file.exists("constant_array_temp_1841.RDS")) {
  const_temp <- try(readRDS("constant_array_temp_1841.RDS"), silent=TRUE)
}

gamma_unfished_max_dev <- 3.0    # allow up to 3x increase (or 1/3x decrease) before stronger penalty
gamma_unfished_soft_dev <- 1.5   # soft threshold start (1.5x)
gamma_unfished_penalty_scale <- 5  # scale multiplier for squared log deviation beyond soft band

# Biomass-to-bounds objective settings
biomass_penalty_enable <- TRUE             # include biomass bounds fit in objective
biomass_comparison_years <- 2000:2010      # model years to average for comparison
biomass_penalty_weight <- 1.0              # weight for biomass penalty relative to yield MSE (tune as needed)

# Helper: compute penalty for deviation of mean modeled biomass from observed bounds
# Returns average per-species penalty (0 inside bounds; squared relative deviation to nearest bound outside)
compute_biomass_bounds_penalty <- function(bmat, obs_bounds, years = 2000:2010){
  # bmat: matrix from getBiomass(sim) [years x species] with rownames as years
  # obs_bounds: data.frame with Species, Lower_g, Upper_g
  if (is.null(bmat) || is.null(obs_bounds)) return(0)
  yrs_b <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rownames(bmat)))
  if (any(is.na(yrs_b))) return(0)
  use_years <- intersect(yrs_b, years)
  if (!length(use_years)) return(0)
  bm_mean <- colMeans(bmat[as.character(use_years), , drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
  # Align species
  sp_mod <- names(bm_mean)
  # Ensure obs_bounds has expected columns
  needed_cols <- c("Species","Lower_g","Upper_g")
  if (!all(needed_cols %in% colnames(obs_bounds))) return(0)
  ob <- obs_bounds
  # Bring to same species set
  common <- intersect(sp_mod, as.character(ob$Species))
  if (!length(common)) return(0)
  # Build vectors aligned to common
  bm_vec <- bm_mean[common]
  ob_sub <- ob[match(common, as.character(ob$Species)), ]
  lower <- as.numeric(ob_sub$Lower_g)
  upper <- as.numeric(ob_sub$Upper_g)
  # Guard against invalid bounds
  valid <- is.finite(bm_vec) & is.finite(lower) & is.finite(upper) & (upper > 0) & (lower > 0)
  if (!any(valid)) return(0)
  bm_vec <- bm_vec[valid]; lower <- lower[valid]; upper <- upper[valid]
  below <- bm_vec < lower
  above <- bm_vec > upper
  pen <- numeric(length(bm_vec))
  # Relative squared deviation to nearest bound
  pen[below] <- ((lower[below] - bm_vec[below]) / pmax(lower[below], 1e-12))^2
  pen[above] <- ((bm_vec[above] - upper[above]) / pmax(upper[above], 1e-12))^2
  # Within bounds contributes 0
  mean(pen, na.rm=TRUE)
}

objective_yield <- function(par_vec){
  p_mod <- try(apply_param_vector(base_params_opt, par_vec), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(p_mod, "try-error")) return(1e12)

  # 1. Fast steady() screen
  if (steady_screen_enable) {
    p_mod <- try(steady(p_mod, t_max = steady_tmax_opt, progress=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
    if (inherits(p_mod, "try-error") || is.null(p_mod)) return(5e11)
  }

  # 2. Enhanced multi-cycle unfished spin-up with stability checks (effort=0)
  spin_final_n <- NULL
  if (spinup_screen_enable) {
    # Ensure enhanced stability function exists; else fallback to legacy quick check
    use_enhanced <- exists("check_biomass_stability_enhanced", inherits=TRUE) &&
      all(c("stability_cv_threshold","stability_check_years_tail","stability_trend_first_years",
            "stability_trend_rel_slope_max","stability_trend_pval_max","stability_min_mean_biomass") %in% ls(envir=.GlobalEnv))
    prev_n <- NULL
    stable_achieved <- FALSE
    if (use_enhanced) {
      for (cy in seq_len(opt_spinup_cycles)) {
    # Avoid passing initial_n=NULL (can trigger replacement length zero in project)
        spin_sim <- try(
          if (is.null(prev_n)) {
            project(p_mod, effort = 0, t_start = 1841, t_max = spinup_years_opt)
          } else {
      project(p_mod, effort = 0, initial_n = prev_n, t_start = 1841, t_max = spinup_years_opt)
          },
          silent=TRUE
        )
        if (inherits(spin_sim, "try-error") || is.null(spin_sim)) return(4e11 + cy)
        stab <- try(check_biomass_stability_enhanced(
          spin_sim,
          tolerance = if (opt_override_stability) opt_stability_cv_threshold else stability_cv_threshold,
          check_years = stability_check_years_tail,
          trend_first_years = stability_trend_first_years,
          trend_rel_slope_max = if (opt_override_stability) opt_stability_trend_rel_slope_max else stability_trend_rel_slope_max,
          trend_pval = stability_trend_pval_max,
          min_mean_biomass = stability_min_mean_biomass,
          verbose = FALSE
        ), silent=TRUE)
        if (inherits(stab, "try-error") || is.null(stab$stable)) return(4.2e11 + cy)
  # Use last available time slice (robust if spinup_years_opt not fully realized)
  prev_n <- tryCatch({ spin_sim@n[dim(spin_sim@n)[1],,] }, error=function(e) NULL)
  # Ensure shape/order compatibility before next cycle
  prev_n <- sanitize_initial_n(p_mod, prev_n)
        if (isTRUE(stab$stable)) {
          if (opt_spinup_early_exit && cy >= opt_spinup_min_cycles) { stable_achieved <- TRUE; break }
          if (cy == opt_spinup_cycles) stable_achieved <- TRUE
        } else {
          if (cy == opt_spinup_cycles) return(1.85e11)  # failed final stability
        }
      }
  spin_final_n <- prev_n
    } else {
      # Fallback: single legacy window test
  spin_sim <- try(project(p_mod, effort = 0, t_start = 1841, t_max = spinup_years_opt), silent=TRUE)
      if (inherits(spin_sim, "try-error") || is.null(spin_sim)) return(4.5e11)
      bm_spin <- try(getBiomass(spin_sim), silent=TRUE)
      if (inherits(bm_spin, "try-error") || is.null(bm_spin)) return(4.5e11)
      yrs_spin <- as.numeric(rownames(bm_spin))
      if (length(yrs_spin) < (2*stability_window+1)) return(4.4e11)
      last_idx <- tail(seq_along(yrs_spin), stability_window)
      prev_idx <- (last_idx[1]-stability_window):(last_idx[1]-1)
      bm_last_mat <- bm_spin[last_idx,,drop=FALSE]; bm_prev_mat <- bm_spin[prev_idx,,drop=FALSE]
      bm_last_mean <- colMeans(bm_last_mat); bm_prev_mean <- colMeans(bm_prev_mat)
      rel_change <- abs(bm_last_mean - bm_prev_mean) / pmax(bm_prev_mean, 1e-12)
      bm_last_sd <- apply(bm_last_mat, 2, sd, na.rm=TRUE); bm_last_cv <- bm_last_sd / pmax(bm_last_mean, 1e-12)
      if (any(is.nan(rel_change))) return(4.3e11)
      if (max(rel_change, na.rm=TRUE) > stability_rel_change_max) return(4.25e11)
      if (max(bm_last_cv, na.rm=TRUE) > stability_cv_max) return(4.2e11)
      if (any(bm_last_mean < extinction_threshold, na.rm=TRUE)) {
        nf_mask <- names(bm_last_mean) %in% non_fished_species
        if (!protect_non_fished || any(bm_last_mean[nf_mask] < extinction_threshold, na.rm=TRUE)) return(4.15e11)
      }
  spin_final_n <- tryCatch({ spin_sim@n[dim(spin_sim@n)[1],,] }, error=function(e) NULL)
    }
  }

  # 3. Main projection for evaluation starting from spin-up terminal state (with fishing effort)
  sim_years <- max(match_years) - 1841 + 1
  if (!is.null(spin_final_n)) {
    sim <- try(project(p_mod, effort = combined_effort_array, initial_n = spin_final_n, t_start = 1841, t_max = sim_years), silent=TRUE)
  } else {
    sim <- try(project(p_mod, effort = combined_effort_array, t_start = 1841, t_max = sim_years), silent=TRUE)
  }
  if (inherits(sim, "try-error") || is.null(sim)) return(1e11)
  ymat <- try(getYield(sim), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(ymat, "try-error")) return(1e10)
  yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(ymat))
  keep_idx <- yrs %in% match_years
  if (!any(keep_idx)) return(1e9)
  ysub <- ymat[keep_idx, , drop=FALSE]
  pred_df <- reshape2::melt(ysub)
  colnames(pred_df) <- c("Year","Species","Yield")
  pred_df$Species <- as.character(pred_df$Species)
  pred_df <- pred_df[pred_df$Species %in% obs_yield_species,]
  if (!nrow(pred_df)) return(1e9)
  obs_sub <- yield_ts_tidy %>% dplyr::filter(Year %in% match_years, Species %in% obs_yield_species)
  if (!nrow(obs_sub)) return(1e9)
  df_join <- dplyr::inner_join(obs_sub, pred_df, by=c("Year","Species"), suffix=c("_obs","_pred"))
  if (!nrow(df_join)) return(1e8)
  obs_t <- df_join$Yield_obs / 1e6
  pred_t <- pmax(df_join$Yield_pred, 0) / 1e6
  err <- (log10(1 + pred_t) - log10(1 + obs_t))^2
  mse <- mean(err)
  penalty_zero <- mean(obs_t > 0 & pred_t <= 1e-9) * 0.5
  penalty_high <- mean(pred_t > (50 * (obs_t + 1e-9))) * 0.2
  # Extract gamma log segment based on layout: catch (nf) + gamma (na_full) + [abundance (na_full)]
  if (species_gamma){
    gamma_logs <- par_vec[(nf+1):(nf+na_full)]
  } else {
    gamma_logs <- par_vec[nf+1]  # single shared gamma log
  }
  penalty_gamma <- mean(gamma_logs^2) * 0.01
  # Additional penalty: unfished species gamma drifting far from baseline
  sp_mod <- species_params(p_mod)
  current_gamma <- setNames(sp_mod$gamma, sp_mod$species)
  unfished <- intersect(non_fished_species, names(current_gamma))
  if (length(unfished)) {
    base_g <- baseline_gamma_all[unfished]
    cur_g <- current_gamma[unfished]
    # log deviation
    log_dev <- log(cur_g / base_g)
    abs_dev <- abs(log_dev)
    soft <- log(gamma_unfished_soft_dev)
    hard <- log(gamma_unfished_max_dev)
    # Portion beyond soft threshold (if any)
    excess <- pmax(0, abs_dev - soft)
    # Normalize by (hard - soft) to keep within scale, cap at 1
    norm_excess <- pmin(1, excess / pmax(1e-9, (hard - soft)))
    # Squared penalty emphasizing large drifts
    penalty_unfished_gamma <- mean((norm_excess)^2) * gamma_unfished_penalty_scale
    penalty_gamma <- penalty_gamma + penalty_unfished_gamma
  }
  penalty_abund <- 0
  if (include_abundance_scaling) {
    # Recompute base lengths with new structure: catch (nf) + gamma (na_full)
    base_len <- if (species_gamma) nf + na_full else (nf + 1)
    abund_logs <- par_vec[(base_len+1):(base_len+na_full)]
    penalty_abund <- mean(abund_logs^2) * 0.005
  }
  # 4. Biomass decline penalty (projection robustness)
  penalty_decline <- 0
  if (decline_penalty_enable) {
    bmat <- try(getBiomass(sim), silent=TRUE)
    if (!inherits(bmat, "try-error") && !is.null(bmat)) {
      yrs_b <- as.numeric(rownames(bmat))
      # limit to calibration years intersection
      common_years <- intersect(yrs_b, match_years)
      if (length(common_years) >= (2 * decline_window_mean)) {
        early_years <- head(sort(common_years), decline_window_mean)
        late_years  <- tail(sort(common_years), decline_window_mean)
        early_mean <- colMeans(bmat[as.character(early_years), , drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
        late_mean  <- colMeans(bmat[as.character(late_years),  , drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
        species_pool <- if (decline_species_mode == "fished") fished_species else sentinel_decline_species
        species_pool <- intersect(species_pool, names(early_mean))
        if (length(species_pool)) {
          start_b <- early_mean[species_pool]
          end_b   <- late_mean[species_pool]
            # Filter extremely low starting biomasses to avoid noise-driven penalties
          valid <- start_b > 10  # grams threshold (adjust if necessary)
          if (any(valid)) {
            ratio <- end_b[valid] / pmax(start_b[valid], 1e-12)
            shortfall <- pmax(0, decline_threshold - ratio)
            if (any(shortfall > 0)) {
              penalty_decline <- mean(shortfall^2) * decline_penalty_scale
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  # 5. Biomass-to-bounds penalty (mean 2000–2010 vs 2010–2020 observed bounds)
  # Compute independently of decline penalty settings
  penalty_biomass <- 0
  if (isTRUE(biomass_penalty_enable) && exists("obs_biomass_bounds")) {
    # Reuse bmat if available, else compute
    if (!exists("bmat") || inherits(bmat, "try-error") || is.null(bmat)) {
      bmat <- try(getBiomass(sim), silent=TRUE)
    }
    if (!inherits(bmat, "try-error") && !is.null(bmat)) {
      penalty_biomass <- compute_biomass_bounds_penalty(bmat, obs_biomass_bounds, years = biomass_comparison_years)
    }
  }
  # Combine objective components
  total_obj <- mse + penalty_zero + penalty_high + penalty_gamma + penalty_abund + penalty_decline
  total_obj <- total_obj + biomass_penalty_weight * penalty_biomass
  total_obj
}

# Bounds
  # Bounds: catchability (fished), gamma (all), abundance (all)
if (species_gamma){
  lower <- c(rep(log(0.05), nf), rep(log(0.2), na_full))
  upper <- c(rep(log(20),  nf), rep(log(5),  na_full))
} else {
  lower <- c(rep(log(0.05), nf), log(0.2))
  upper <- c(rep(log(20),  nf), log(5))
}
if (include_abundance_scaling) {
  abund_lower <- numeric(na_full); abund_upper <- numeric(na_full)
  for (i in seq_len(na_full)){
    s <- all_species_full[i]
    rowi <- abundance_info[abundance_info$species==s,]
    if (nrow(rowi)==1){
      lo <- rowi$q10 * 0.9; hi <- rowi$q90 * 1.1
      lo <- max(lo, 0.05); hi <- max(hi, lo*1.05)
    } else { lo <- 0.5; hi <- 2 }
    abund_lower[i] <- log(lo); abund_upper[i] <- log(hi)
  }
  lower <- c(lower, abund_lower); upper <- c(upper, abund_upper)
}

cat("Parameter vector length:", length(lower), if (species_gamma) " (catch + gamma per species" else " (catch + 1 gamma", if (include_abundance_scaling) "+ abundance per species)" else ")", "\n", sep="")

par_dim <- length(lower)
if (!requireNamespace("DEoptim", quietly=TRUE)) { cat("Installing DEoptim (first time)...\n"); install.packages("DEoptim") }
library(DEoptim)

set.seed(1234)
quick_opt_test <- exists("quick_opt_test") && isTRUE(quick_opt_test)
iter_full <- 1000
NP_full <- max(10 * par_dim, 80)
if (quick_opt_test){ iter_full <- 1; NP_full <- min(max(2 * par_dim, 10), 60) }
de_ctrl <- DEoptim.control(parallelType = 0, strategy=2, reltol= if (quick_opt_test) 1e-4 else 1e-6,
                           itermax=iter_full, NP=NP_full, CR=0.9, F=0.8, trace=10)
cat("DEoptim setup: itermax=", de_ctrl$itermax, ", NP=", de_ctrl$NP, ", reltol=", de_ctrl$reltol, "\n", sep="")

use_parallel_opt <- exists("use_parallel_opt") && isTRUE(use_parallel_opt)
if (!exists("use_parallel_opt")) use_parallel_opt <- TRUE  # default on
n_cores_opt <- if (exists("n_cores_opt")) n_cores_opt else max(1, parallel::detectCores()-1)
cl <- NULL
if (use_parallel_opt && n_cores_opt > 1){
  cat("Initializing parallel cluster with", n_cores_opt, "workers...\n")
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores_opt)
  on.exit(try(parallel::stopCluster(cl), silent=TRUE), add=TRUE)
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, { library(therMizer); library(mizer); library(dplyr); library(reshape2); library(tidyr) })
  # Export needed symbols (objective_yield will re-use these from cluster environment)
  export_syms <- c("objective_yield","base_params_opt","apply_param_vector","sanitize_initial_n",
                   "steady_screen_enable","steady_tmax_opt","spinup_screen_enable","spinup_years_opt",
                   "stability_window","stability_rel_change_max","stability_cv_max","extinction_threshold",
                   "protect_non_fished","non_fished_species","match_years","combined_effort_array",
                   "yield_ts_tidy","obs_yield_species","species_gamma","include_abundance_scaling","nf",
                   "na_full","baseline_gamma_all","gamma_unfished_max_dev","gamma_unfished_soft_dev",
                   "gamma_unfished_penalty_scale","check_biomass_stability_enhanced","stability_cv_threshold",
                   "stability_check_years_tail","stability_trend_first_years","stability_trend_rel_slope_max",
                   "stability_trend_pval_max","stability_min_mean_biomass","opt_spinup_cycles",
                   "opt_spinup_early_exit","opt_spinup_min_cycles","opt_override_stability",
                   "opt_stability_cv_threshold","opt_stability_trend_rel_slope_max","decline_penalty_enable",
                   "decline_species_mode","sentinel_decline_species","decline_threshold","decline_penalty_scale",
                   "decline_window_mean","obs_biomass_bounds","biomass_penalty_enable",
                   "biomass_comparison_years","biomass_penalty_weight","compute_biomass_bounds_penalty")
  parallel::clusterExport(cl, export_syms, envir=environment())
  de_ctrl$parallelType <- 2
  de_ctrl$cluster <- cl
  cat("Launching DEoptim (parallel mode)...\n")
} else {
  cat("Launching DEoptim (serial mode)...\n")
}

opt_res <- tryCatch({ DEoptim(fn = objective_yield, lower = lower, upper = upper, control = de_ctrl) },
                    error = function(e){ cat("DEoptim failed: ", conditionMessage(e), "\n", sep=""); NULL })

if (is.null(opt_res)) {
  cat("Optimization failed – aborting extraction.\n")
} else {
  cat("Optimization complete. Best objective:", opt_res$optim$bestval, "\n")
  best_par <- opt_res$optim$bestmem
}

# Split parameter vector
if (exists("best_par")) {
  if (species_gamma){
    best_catch_logs <- best_par[1:nf]
    best_gamma_logs <- best_par[(nf+1):(nf+na_full)]
    offset <- nf + na_full
  } else {
    best_catch_logs <- best_par[1:nf]
    best_gamma_logs <- rep(best_par[nf+1], na_full)
    offset <- nf + 1
  }
  if (include_abundance_scaling){
    best_abundance_logs <- best_par[(offset+1):(offset+na_full)]
    best_abundance_mult <- exp(best_abundance_logs)
  } else { best_abundance_logs <- rep(0, na_full); best_abundance_mult <- rep(1, na_full) }
  best_catch_mult <- exp(best_catch_logs); best_gamma_mult <- exp(best_gamma_logs)
}

# ---- Post-optimization: evaluate top-K candidates and select a balanced solution ----
topK_enable <- TRUE
topK_count <- 10

# Helper: indices for vector layout
get_layout_indices <- function(){
  idx <- list()
  idx$catch <- 1:nf
  if (species_gamma) {
    idx$gamma <- (nf+1):(nf+na_full)
    base_off <- nf + na_full
  } else {
    idx$gamma <- nf + 1
    base_off <- nf + 1
  }
  if (include_abundance_scaling) idx$abund <- (base_off+1):(base_off+na_full) else idx$abund <- integer(0)
  idx
}

# Helper: run unfished spin-up screen once and return final state and stability
spinup_once <- function(p_mod){
  spin_final_n <- NULL; stable_flag <- NA
  if (!spinup_screen_enable) return(list(n=spin_final_n, stable=stable_flag))
  use_enhanced <- exists("check_biomass_stability_enhanced", inherits=TRUE) &&
    all(c("stability_cv_threshold","stability_check_years_tail","stability_trend_first_years",
          "stability_trend_rel_slope_max","stability_trend_pval_max","stability_min_mean_biomass") %in% ls(envir=.GlobalEnv))
  prev_n <- NULL
  if (use_enhanced) {
    for (cy in seq_len(opt_spinup_cycles)){
      sim0 <- try(if (is.null(prev_n)) project(p_mod, effort=0, t_start=1841, t_max=spinup_years_opt)
                  else project(p_mod, effort=0, initial_n=prev_n, t_start=1841, t_max=spinup_years_opt), silent=TRUE)
      if (inherits(sim0, "try-error") || is.null(sim0)) return(list(n=NULL, stable=FALSE))
      stab <- try(check_biomass_stability_enhanced(
        sim0,
        tolerance = if (opt_override_stability) opt_stability_cv_threshold else stability_cv_threshold,
        check_years = stability_check_years_tail,
        trend_first_years = stability_trend_first_years,
        trend_rel_slope_max = if (opt_override_stability) opt_stability_trend_rel_slope_max else stability_trend_rel_slope_max,
        trend_pval = stability_trend_pval_max,
        min_mean_biomass = stability_min_mean_biomass,
        verbose = FALSE
      ), silent=TRUE)
      if (inherits(stab, "try-error") || is.null(stab$stable)) return(list(n=NULL, stable=FALSE))
      prev_n <- tryCatch({ sim0@n[dim(sim0@n)[1],,] }, error=function(e) NULL)
      prev_n <- sanitize_initial_n(p_mod, prev_n)
      if (isTRUE(stab$stable) && (!opt_spinup_early_exit || cy >= opt_spinup_min_cycles)) { stable_flag <- TRUE; break }
      if (cy == opt_spinup_cycles) stable_flag <- isTRUE(stab$stable)
    }
    spin_final_n <- prev_n
  } else {
    sim0 <- try(project(p_mod, effort=0, t_start=1841, t_max=spinup_years_opt), silent=TRUE)
    if (inherits(sim0, "try-error") || is.null(sim0)) return(list(n=NULL, stable=FALSE))
    spin_final_n <- tryCatch({ sim0@n[dim(sim0@n)[1],,] }, error=function(e) NULL)
    spin_final_n <- sanitize_initial_n(p_mod, spin_final_n)
    stable_flag <- TRUE
  }
  list(n=spin_final_n, stable=stable_flag)
}

# Helper: evaluate candidate vector with key metrics
evaluate_candidate <- function(par_vec){
  p_mod <- try(apply_param_vector(base_params_opt, par_vec), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(p_mod, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  if (steady_screen_enable) {
    p_mod <- try(steady(p_mod, t_max = steady_tmax_opt, progress=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
    if (inherits(p_mod, "try-error") || is.null(p_mod)) return(NULL)
  }
  su <- spinup_once(p_mod)
  sim_years <- max(match_years) - 1841 + 1
  sim <- try(if (!is.null(su$n)) project(p_mod, effort=combined_effort_array, initial_n=su$n, t_start=1841, t_max=sim_years)
             else project(p_mod, effort=combined_effort_array, t_start=1841, t_max=sim_years), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(sim, "try-error") || is.null(sim)) return(NULL)
  obj <- try(objective_yield(par_vec), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(obj, "try-error")) obj <- NA_real_
  # whale metrics
  bmat <- try(getBiomass(sim), silent=TRUE)
  whales_species <- grep("whale", species_params(p_mod)$species, ignore.case=TRUE, value=TRUE)
  whales_species <- intersect(whales_species, colnames(bmat))
  minke_ratio <- NA_real_; whales_ratio <- NA_real_
  if (!inherits(bmat, "try-error") && !is.null(bmat) && length(whales_species)) {
    yrs_b <- as.numeric(rownames(bmat))
    common_years <- intersect(yrs_b, match_years)
    if (length(common_years) >= 10){
      early <- head(sort(common_years), 5); late <- tail(sort(common_years), 5)
      early_mean <- colMeans(bmat[as.character(early), whales_species, drop=FALSE])
      late_mean  <- colMeans(bmat[as.character(late),  whales_species, drop=FALSE])
      ratios <- late_mean / pmax(early_mean, 1e-12)
      whales_ratio <- mean(ratios, na.rm=TRUE)
      if ("minke whales" %in% names(early_mean)) minke_ratio <- as.numeric(late_mean["minke whales"]) / pmax(as.numeric(early_mean["minke whales"]), 1e-12)
    }
  }
  list(objective=as.numeric(obj), stable=as.logical(su$stable), minke_ratio=minke_ratio, whales_ratio=whales_ratio, params=p_mod, sim=sim, par_vec=par_vec)
}

top_candidates <- NULL; top_summary <- NULL; best_balanced <- NULL
if (topK_enable && exists("opt_res") && !is.null(opt_res)){
  pop <- try(opt_res$member$pop, silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(pop, "try-error") || is.null(pop)) pop <- NULL
  if (is.null(pop)) {
    # Fallback: jitter around best
    set.seed(123)
    cand_mat <- replicate(topK_count, best_par + rnorm(length(best_par), sd=0.05))
    cand_mat <- t(cand_mat)
  } else {
    cand_mat <- as.matrix(pop)
  }
  # Ensure candidates are rows
  if (ncol(cand_mat) == length(lower)) {
    cand_list <- split(cand_mat, row(cand_mat)[,1])
  } else if (nrow(cand_mat) == length(lower)) {
    cand_list <- split(t(cand_mat), row(t(cand_mat))[,1])
  } else {
    cand_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cand_mat)), function(i) cand_mat[i,])
  }
  # Evaluate all candidates and rank
  evals <- lapply(cand_list, function(v){ v <- as.numeric(v); names(v) <- NULL; evaluate_candidate(v) })
  ok <- sapply(evals, function(x) !is.null(x) && is.finite(x$objective))
  evals_ok <- evals[ok]
  if (length(evals_ok)){
    obj_vals <- sapply(evals_ok, function(x) x$objective)
    ord <- order(obj_vals)
    keep <- seq_len(min(topK_count, length(ord)))
    sel <- evals_ok[ord[keep]]
    top_candidates <- sel
    top_summary <- data.frame(
      rank = seq_along(sel),
      objective = sapply(sel, function(x) x$objective),
      stable_spinup = sapply(sel, function(x) isTRUE(x$stable)),
      minke_ratio = sapply(sel, function(x) x$minke_ratio),
      whales_ratio = sapply(sel, function(x) x$whales_ratio)
    )
    cat("\nTop-", nrow(top_summary), " candidates (by objective):\n", sep="")
    print(top_summary)
    # Choose balanced: prefer spin-up-stable and minke_ratio >= decline_threshold; else best objective
    good <- which(sapply(sel, function(x) isTRUE(x$stable) && !is.na(x$minke_ratio) && x$minke_ratio >= decline_threshold))
    pick <- if (length(good)) good[which.min(sapply(sel[good], function(x) x$objective))] else 1
    best_balanced <- sel[[pick]]
  }
}

# Optional whales-focused local refinement around chosen candidate
whales_refine_enable <- TRUE
whales_refine_maxit <- 120
whales_refine_strength <- 2.0  # weight for whales biomass penalty

refine_whales_candidate <- function(base_par){
  lay <- get_layout_indices()
  whales <- grep("whale", all_species_full, ignore.case=TRUE, value=TRUE)
  if (!length(whales)) return(list(par=base_par, improved=FALSE))
  # Variables: gamma logs for whales (abundance optional off by default to keep small)
  idx_gamma_whales <- lay$gamma[which(all_species_full %in% whales)]
  if (!length(idx_gamma_whales)) return(list(par=base_par, improved=FALSE))
  par0 <- rep(0, length(idx_gamma_whales))  # relative adjustments in log-space
  lower_rel <- rep(-0.5, length(par0))  # ~60% down
  upper_rel <- rep(0.5,  length(par0))  # ~65% up
  whales_objective <- function(delta){
    pv <- base_par
    pv[idx_gamma_whales] <- pv[idx_gamma_whales] + as.numeric(delta)
    # Main objective
    o <- try(objective_yield(pv), silent=TRUE); if (inherits(o, "try-error")) o <- 1e12
    # Extra whales biomass penalty
    p_mod <- try(apply_param_vector(base_params_opt, pv), silent=TRUE)
    if (!inherits(p_mod, "try-error")){
      if (steady_screen_enable) p_mod <- try(steady(p_mod, t_max=steady_tmax_opt, progress=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
      if (!inherits(p_mod, "try-error") && !is.null(p_mod)){
        su <- spinup_once(p_mod)
        sim_years <- max(match_years) - 1841 + 1
        sim <- try(if (!is.null(su$n)) project(p_mod, effort=combined_effort_array, initial_n=su$n, t_start=1841, t_max=sim_years)
                   else project(p_mod, effort=combined_effort_array, t_start=1841, t_max=sim_years), silent=TRUE)
        bpen <- 0
        if (!(inherits(sim, "try-error") || is.null(sim))){
          bmat <- try(getBiomass(sim), silent=TRUE)
          if (!(inherits(bmat, "try-error") || is.null(bmat))){
            yrs_b <- as.numeric(rownames(bmat)); common <- intersect(yrs_b, match_years)
            if (length(common) >= 10){
              early <- head(sort(common), 5); late <- tail(sort(common), 5)
              em <- colMeans(bmat[as.character(early), whales, drop=FALSE])
              lm <- colMeans(bmat[as.character(late),  whales, drop=FALSE])
              ratio <- lm / pmax(em, 1e-12)
              # penalize declines below threshold and extreme explosions > 3x
              shortfall <- pmax(0, decline_threshold - ratio)
              explode <- pmax(0, ratio - 3)
              bpen <- mean(shortfall^2 + 0.25*explode^2)
            }
          }
        }
        o <- o + whales_refine_strength * bpen
      }
    }
    o
  }
  opt2 <- try(optim(par=par0, fn=whales_objective, method="L-BFGS-B", lower=lower_rel, upper=upper_rel, control=list(maxit=whales_refine_maxit)), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(opt2, "try-error")) return(list(par=base_par, improved=FALSE))
  new_par <- base_par; new_par[idx_gamma_whales] <- new_par[idx_gamma_whales] + opt2$par
  list(par=new_par, improved=TRUE, value=opt2$value)
}

selected_par <- if (!is.null(best_balanced)) best_balanced$par_vec else if (exists("best_par")) best_par else NULL
if (!is.null(selected_par) && whales_refine_enable){
  ref <- refine_whales_candidate(selected_par)
  if (isTRUE(ref$improved)) {
    cat("Applied whales-focused refinement to selected candidate.\n")
    selected_par <- ref$par
  }
}


# Construct and save calibrated params
final_par_vec <- if (exists("selected_par")) selected_par else if (exists("best_par")) best_par else NULL
if (!is.null(final_par_vec)) {
  # derive logs and multipliers for the chosen vector
  if (species_gamma){
    final_catch_logs <- final_par_vec[1:nf]
    final_gamma_logs <- final_par_vec[(nf+1):(nf+na_full)]
    final_offset <- nf + na_full
  } else {
    final_catch_logs <- final_par_vec[1:nf]
    final_gamma_logs <- rep(final_par_vec[nf+1], na_full)
    final_offset <- nf + 1
  }
  if (include_abundance_scaling){
    final_abundance_logs <- final_par_vec[(final_offset+1):(final_offset+na_full)]
    final_abundance_mult <- exp(final_abundance_logs)
  } else { final_abundance_logs <- NULL; final_abundance_mult <- NULL }
  final_catch_mult <- exp(final_catch_logs); final_gamma_mult <- exp(final_gamma_logs)

  calibrated_params <- apply_param_vector(base_params_opt, final_par_vec)
  out_dir <- file.path("Output_large_files","parameter_optimization")
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)
  stamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
  save_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("yield_optimization_result_", stamp, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(list(
  # Save enough to rebuild and reuse candidates later
  candidate_vectors = if (!is.null(top_candidates)) lapply(top_candidates, function(x) x$par_vec) else NULL,
  candidate_params  = if (!is.null(top_candidates)) lapply(top_candidates, function(x) if (!is.null(x$params)) x$params else NULL) else NULL,
    best_vector = final_par_vec,
    best_objective = if (exists("opt_res") && !is.null(opt_res)) opt_res$optim$bestval else NA_real_,
  fished_species = fished_species,
  all_species = all_species_full,
    catchability_log = final_catch_logs,
    gamma_log = final_gamma_logs,
    abundance_log = final_abundance_logs,
    catchability_mult = final_catch_mult,
    gamma_mult = final_gamma_mult,
    abundance_mult = final_abundance_mult,
    abundance_bounds_source = if (include_abundance_scaling) abundance_info else NULL,
    params = calibrated_params,
    control = de_ctrl,
    species_gamma = species_gamma,
    include_abundance_scaling = include_abundance_scaling,
    top_candidates_summary = if (!is.null(top_summary)) top_summary else NULL
  ), file=save_path)
  cat("Saved optimization results to:", save_path, "\n")
  # Also save a CSV with top-K
  if (!is.null(top_summary)) {
    csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("yield_optimization_topK_", stamp, ".csv"))
    try(utils::write.csv(top_summary, csv_path, row.names=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
    cat("Saved top-K summary to:", csv_path, "\n")
  }
}

# Quick diagnostic: modeled vs observed yields after calibration
if (exists("calibrated_params")) {
  sim_years <- max(match_years) - 1841 + 1
  sim_best <- project(calibrated_params, effort = combined_effort_array, t_start=1841, t_max=sim_years)
  # Build ribbon across top candidates if available; else fallback to single line
  species_target <- if (exists("species_target")) species_target else obs_yield_species
  # Collect candidate sims (precomputed during evaluation)
  candidate_sims <- NULL
  if (exists("top_candidates") && length(top_candidates)) {
    candidate_sims <- lapply(top_candidates, function(x) if (!is.null(x$sim) && !inherits(x$sim, "try-error")) x$sim else NULL)
    candidate_sims <- candidate_sims[sapply(candidate_sims, function(s) !is.null(s))]
  }
  obs_plot <- yield_ts_tidy %>% dplyr::filter(Year %in% match_years, Species %in% species_target, Yield > 0)

  if (!is.null(candidate_sims) && length(candidate_sims) > 0) {
    # Combine yields across candidates with effort-based filtering and gap segmentation
    # Observed-positive-yield proxy for effort by species/year (consistent with MC logic)
    obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>%
      dplyr::mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Year, Species) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')
    cand_long <- lapply(seq_along(candidate_sims), function(i){
      y <- try(getYield(candidate_sims[[i]]), silent=TRUE)
      if (inherits(y, "try-error") || is.null(y)) return(NULL)
      yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(y))
      y <- y[yrs %in% match_years, , drop=FALSE]
      if (!nrow(y)) return(NULL)
      dd <- reshape2::melt(y)
      colnames(dd) <- c("Year","Species","Yield")
      dd$Species <- as.character(dd$Species)
      dd <- dd[dd$Species %in% species_target, ]
  # Observed-based zero-year filter and log-safe preparation will happen after aggregation
      dd <- dd[order(dd$Species, dd$Year), ]
      dd <- dd %>% dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% dplyr::mutate(seg = cumsum(c(0, diff(Year) > 1))) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
      dd$candidate <- paste0("cand_", i)
      dd
    })
    cand_long <- Filter(Negate(is.null), cand_long)
    if (length(cand_long)) {
      all_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(cand_long)
      summary_df <- all_df %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Yield_t = pmax(Yield / 1e6, 0)) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Year, Species) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          q05 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Yield_t, 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)),
          q25 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Yield_t, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE)),
          median = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Yield_t, 0.5, na.rm=TRUE)),
          q75 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Yield_t, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE)),
          q95 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Yield_t, 0.95, na.rm=TRUE)),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by = c("Year","Species")) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(has_obs_pos = dplyr::coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))
      summary_ribbon <- summary_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(q95) | q95 <= 0))) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(q05 = ifelse(q05 > 0, q05, NA_real_), q25 = ifelse(q25 > 0, q25, NA_real_), q75 = ifelse(q75 > 0, q75, NA_real_), q95 = ifelse(q95 > 0, q95, NA_real_)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!(is.na(q25) & is.na(q75) & is.na(q05) & is.na(q95))) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(Species, Year) %>% dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% dplyr::mutate(seg = cumsum(c(0, diff(Year) > 1))) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
      summary_line <- summary_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(!(has_obs_pos == FALSE & (is.na(median) | median <= 0))) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(median = ifelse(median > 0, median, NA_real_)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(Species, Year) %>% dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% dplyr::mutate(seg = cumsum(c(0, diff(Year) > 1))) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
      ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data=summary_ribbon, aes(x=Year, ymin=q05, ymax=q95, fill=Species), alpha=0.2, show.legend=FALSE) +
  geom_ribbon(data=summary_ribbon, aes(x=Year, ymin=q25, ymax=q75, fill=Species), alpha=0.3, show.legend=FALSE) +
  geom_line(data=summary_line, aes(x=Year, y=median, colour=Species, group=interaction(Species, seg)), linewidth=0.9) +
        geom_point(data=obs_plot, aes(Year, Yield/1e6, colour=Species), size=1) +
        geom_point(data=obs_plot, aes(Year, Yield/1e6), colour="black", shape=1, size=1) +
        scale_y_log10(labels=function(x) scales::label_number()(x)) +
        theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="bottom") +
        facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") +
        labs(title="Top candidates: Yields (median + spread) vs Observations", y="Yield [t/year] (log10)")
    } else {
      # Fallback to single line when no usable candidates
      ymat_best <- getYield(sim_best)
      yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(ymat_best))
      ymat_best <- ymat_best[yrs %in% match_years,,drop=FALSE]
      pred_best <- reshape2::melt(ymat_best)
      colnames(pred_best) <- c("Year","Species","Yield")
      pred_best <- pred_best[pred_best$Species %in% species_target,]
  # Observed-based zero-year filter: drop zero-only years when no observed yield
  obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>% dplyr::mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>% dplyr::group_by(Year, Species) %>% dplyr::summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups='drop')
  pred_best <- pred_best %>% dplyr::left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by=c("Year","Species")) %>% dplyr::mutate(has_obs_pos = dplyr::coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))
  pred_best$Yield_t <- ifelse(pred_best$has_obs_pos == FALSE & (pred_best$Yield/1e6) <= 0, NA_real_, pred_best$Yield/1e6)
  pred_best <- pred_best[!is.na(pred_best$Yield_t), , drop=FALSE]
      pred_best <- pred_best[order(pred_best$Species, pred_best$Year), ]
      pred_best <- pred_best %>% dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% dplyr::mutate(seg = cumsum(c(0, diff(Year) > 1))) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
      pred_best$Yield_t <- pmax(pred_best$Yield / 1e6, 1e-9)
      obs_plot$Yield_t <- pmax(obs_plot$Yield / 1e6, 1e-9)
      ggplot() +
        geom_line(data=pred_best, aes(Year, Yield_t, colour=Species, group=interaction(Species, seg)), linewidth=0.9) +
        geom_point(data=obs_plot, aes(Year, Yield_t, colour=Species), size=1) +
        geom_point(data=obs_plot, aes(Year, Yield_t), colour="black", shape=1, size=1) +
        scale_y_log10(labels=function(x) scales::label_number()(x)) +
        theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="bottom") +
        facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") +
        labs(title="Optimized Yields vs Observations", y="Yield [t/year] (log10)")
    }
  } else {
    # No top candidates: single calibrated param line with filtering/segmentation
    ymat_best <- getYield(sim_best)
    yrs <- as.numeric(rownames(ymat_best))
    ymat_best <- ymat_best[yrs %in% match_years,,drop=FALSE]
    pred_best <- reshape2::melt(ymat_best)
    colnames(pred_best) <- c("Year","Species","Yield")
    pred_best <- pred_best[pred_best$Species %in% species_target,]
  # Observed-based zero-year filter
  obs_pos_by_year <- yield_ts_tidy %>% dplyr::mutate(has_obs_pos = Yield > 0) %>% dplyr::group_by(Year, Species) %>% dplyr::summarise(has_obs_pos = any(has_obs_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups='drop')
  pred_best <- pred_best %>% dplyr::left_join(obs_pos_by_year, by=c("Year","Species")) %>% dplyr::mutate(has_obs_pos = dplyr::coalesce(has_obs_pos, FALSE))
  pred_best$Yield_t <- ifelse(pred_best$has_obs_pos == FALSE & (pred_best$Yield/1e6) <= 0, NA_real_, pred_best$Yield/1e6)
  pred_best <- pred_best[!is.na(pred_best$Yield_t), , drop=FALSE]
    pred_best <- pred_best[order(pred_best$Species, pred_best$Year), ]
    pred_best <- pred_best %>% dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% dplyr::mutate(seg = cumsum(c(0, diff(Year) > 1))) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
    pred_best$Yield_t <- pmax(pred_best$Yield / 1e6, 1e-9)
    obs_plot$Yield_t <- pmax(obs_plot$Yield / 1e6, 1e-9)
    ggplot() +
      geom_line(data=pred_best, aes(Year, Yield_t, colour=Species, group=interaction(Species, seg)), linewidth=0.9) +
      geom_point(data=obs_plot, aes(Year, Yield_t, colour=Species), size=1) +
      geom_point(data=obs_plot, aes(Year, Yield_t), colour="black", shape=1, size=1) +
      scale_y_log10(labels=function(x) scales::label_number()(x)) +
      theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="bottom") +
      facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") +
      labs(title="Optimized Yields vs Observations", y="Yield [t/year] (log10)")
  }

  # --- Biomass diagnostic plot (optimized) ---
  # Build candidate biomass ribbons if available; else single-line fallback
  # Optional overlay of observed bounds when obs_biomass_* objects exist
  get_obs_bm_ts <- function(){
    missing_bm_objs <- setdiff(c("obs_biomass_data","obs_biomass_bounds"), ls(envir=.GlobalEnv))
    if (length(missing_bm_objs)) return(NULL)
    obs_bm_base <- obs_biomass_data %>% dplyr::left_join(obs_biomass_bounds %>% dplyr::select(Species, Lower=Lower_g, Upper=Upper_g), by="Species")
    if (!"Year" %in% names(obs_bm_base)) {
      tidyr::crossing(obs_bm_base, Year = match_years)
    } else if (any(obs_bm_base$Year %in% match_years)) {
      obs_bm_base %>% dplyr::filter(Year %in% match_years)
    } else {
      tidyr::crossing(obs_bm_base, Year = match_years)
    }
  }
  obs_bm_ts <- get_obs_bm_ts()
  if (!is.null(candidate_sims) && length(candidate_sims) > 0) {
    cand_bm <- lapply(seq_along(candidate_sims), function(i){
      b <- try(getBiomass(candidate_sims[[i]]), silent=TRUE)
      if (inherits(b, "try-error") || is.null(b)) return(NULL)
      yrsb <- as.numeric(rownames(b)); b <- b[yrsb %in% match_years, , drop=FALSE]
      if (!nrow(b)) return(NULL)
      dd <- reshape2::melt(b); colnames(dd) <- c("Year","Species","Biomass"); dd$Species <- as.character(dd$Species); dd
    })
    cand_bm <- Filter(Negate(is.null), cand_bm)
    if (length(cand_bm)) {
      bm_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(cand_bm)
      ribbon_probs_bm <- if (exists("biomass_ribbon_probs")) biomass_ribbon_probs else c(0.1, 0.9)
      bm_summary <- bm_all %>% dplyr::group_by(Year, Species) %>% dplyr::summarise(lower = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Biomass, ribbon_probs_bm[1], na.rm=TRUE)), median = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Biomass, 0.5, na.rm=TRUE)), upper = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Biomass, ribbon_probs_bm[2], na.rm=TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
      p_bm <- ggplot() +
        geom_ribbon(data=bm_summary, aes(x=Year, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, fill=Species), alpha=0.25, show.legend=FALSE) +
        geom_line(data=bm_summary, aes(x=Year, y=median, colour=Species), linewidth=0.9)
      if (!is.null(obs_bm_ts)) {
        p_bm <- p_bm +
          geom_ribbon(data=obs_bm_ts, aes(x=Year, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper), fill="grey60", alpha=0.25) +
          geom_point(data=obs_bm_ts, aes(Year, ObsBiomass, colour=Species), size=0.8, na.rm=TRUE) +
          geom_point(data=obs_bm_ts, aes(Year, ObsBiomass), shape=1, size=0.8, colour="black", na.rm=TRUE)
      }
      p_bm + facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") + scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x) scales::number(x/1e6)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="bottom", strip.text=element_text(face="bold")) + labs(title="Top candidates: Biomass (median + spread) vs Observed Bounds", y="Biomass [t]")
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  } else {
    # Fallback single-set biomass
    bmat_best <- getBiomass(sim_best)
    yrs_b <- as.numeric(rownames(bmat_best))
    bmat_best <- bmat_best[yrs_b %in% match_years,,drop=FALSE]
    bm_pred <- reshape2::melt(bmat_best); colnames(bm_pred) <- c("Year","Species","Biomass"); bm_pred$Species <- as.character(bm_pred$Species)
    p_bm <- ggplot()
    if (!is.null(obs_bm_ts)) {
      p_bm <- p_bm + geom_ribbon(data=obs_bm_ts, aes(x=Year, ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper), fill="grey60", alpha=0.25) + geom_point(data=obs_bm_ts, aes(Year, ObsBiomass, colour=Species), size=0.8, na.rm=TRUE) + geom_point(data=obs_bm_ts, aes(Year, ObsBiomass), shape=1, size=0.8, colour="black", na.rm=TRUE)
    }
    p_bm + geom_line(data=bm_pred, aes(Year, Biomass, colour=Species), linewidth=0.9) + facet_wrap(~Species, scales="free_y") + scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x) scales::number(x/1e6)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="bottom", strip.text=element_text(face="bold")) + labs(title="Optimized Biomass vs Observed Bounds", y="Biomass [t]")
  }
} else {
  cat("Skipping diagnostic plot (no calibrated_params).\n")
}

plotBiomass(sim_best)

# --- Optional spin-up diagnostics for calibrated parameters ---
run_spinup_diagnostics <- exists("run_spinup_diagnostics") && isTRUE(run_spinup_diagnostics)
if (run_spinup_diagnostics && exists("calibrated_params")) {
  cat("\n=== Spin-up Diagnostics (Calibrated Params) ===\n")
  diag_cycles <- if (exists("opt_spinup_cycles")) opt_spinup_cycles else 3
  diag_years  <- if (exists("spinup_years_opt")) spinup_years_opt else 118
  sentinels_default <- c("minke whales","leopard seals")
  sentinel_species <- if (exists("spinup_sentinel_species")) spinup_sentinel_species else sentinels_default
  sentinel_species <- sentinel_species[sentinel_species %in% species_params(calibrated_params)$species]
  if (!length(sentinel_species)) sentinel_species <- species_params(calibrated_params)$species[1:min(5, nrow(species_params(calibrated_params)))]
  # Re-run steady() explicitly to capture baseline biomasses pre spin-up
  base_after_steady <- try(steady(calibrated_params, t_max = if (exists("steady_tmax_opt")) steady_tmax_opt else 250, progress=FALSE), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(base_after_steady, "try-error")) { cat("steady() failed for diagnostics; aborting diagnostics.\n") } else {
    b0 <- getBiomass(project(base_after_steady, effort=0, t_start=1841, t_max=1))
    b0_vec <- tail(b0,1)[1, sentinel_species, drop=FALSE]
    cat("Initial (post-steady) biomass (sentinels):\n")
    print(format(round(as.numeric(b0_vec),2), scientific=TRUE)); names(b0_vec) <- sentinel_species
    prev_n <- NULL
    cycle_records <- list()
    for (cy in seq_len(diag_cycles)) {
      # Avoid passing initial_n = NULL to project() on first cycle
      sim_cy <- try(
        if (is.null(prev_n)) {
          project(base_after_steady, effort=0, t_start=1841, t_max=diag_years)
        } else {
          project(base_after_steady, effort=0, initial_n = prev_n, t_start=1841, t_max=diag_years)
        },
        silent=TRUE
      )
      if (inherits(sim_cy, "try-error") || is.null(sim_cy)) {
        cat("Cycle", cy, "failed (projection error). Message: ", if (inherits(sim_cy, "try-error")) as.character(sim_cy) else "NULL", "\n", sep="")
        break
      }
      bm <- getBiomass(sim_cy)
      yrs_bm <- as.numeric(rownames(bm))
      start_slice <- bm[1, sentinel_species, drop=FALSE]
      end_slice   <- bm[nrow(bm), sentinel_species, drop=FALSE]
      rel_change <- as.numeric(end_slice) / pmax(as.numeric(start_slice), 1e-12) - 1
      stab <- if (exists("check_biomass_stability_enhanced")) try(check_biomass_stability_enhanced(sim_cy, verbose=FALSE), silent=TRUE) else NULL
      stable_flag <- if (!is.null(stab) && !inherits(stab, "try-error")) stab$stable else NA
      fail_cv_n <- if (!is.null(stab) && !inherits(stab, "try-error")) sum(stab$fail_cv, na.rm=TRUE) else NA_integer_
      fail_trend_n <- if (!is.null(stab) && !inherits(stab, "try-error")) sum(stab$fail_trend, na.rm=TRUE) else NA_integer_
      cycle_records[[cy]] <- data.frame(
        cycle = cy,
        species = sentinel_species,
        start_biomass = as.numeric(start_slice),
        end_biomass   = as.numeric(end_slice),
        rel_change = rel_change,
        stable_flag = stable_flag,
        n_fail_cv = fail_cv_n,
        n_fail_trend = fail_trend_n
      )
      cat(sprintf("Cycle %d summary (sentinels): max decline %.1f%% | stable=%s | cv_fail=%s | trend_fail=%s\n",
                  cy, 100*max(pmax(-rel_change,0)), stable_flag, fail_cv_n, fail_trend_n))
      # Use last available time slice robustly (in case fewer than diag_years steps were realized)
  prev_n <- tryCatch({ sim_cy@n[dim(sim_cy@n)[1],,] }, error=function(e) NULL)
  prev_n <- sanitize_initial_n(base_after_steady, prev_n)
      if (is.null(prev_n)) {
        cat("Warning: prev_n is NULL after cycle ", cy, ". Subsequent cycles may fail.\n", sep="")
      } else {
        dims <- dim(prev_n); cat("prev_n dims after cycle ", cy, ": ", paste(dims, collapse="x"), " (species x size)\n", sep="")
      }
      if (isTRUE(stable_flag) && exists("opt_spinup_early_exit") && isTRUE(opt_spinup_early_exit) && cy >= (get0("opt_spinup_min_cycles", ifnotfound=2))) {
        cat("Early exit after cycle", cy, "(stable achieved).\n")
        break
      }
    }
    diag_df <- do.call(rbind, cycle_records)
    if (!is.null(diag_df)) {
      cat("\nPer-cycle sentinel biomass changes:\n")
      print(diag_df)
      # Flag problematic early declines (>20% per cycle)
      bad <- subset(diag_df, rel_change < -0.2)
      if (nrow(bad)) {
        cat("WARNING: Sentinel species show >20% decline in a spin-up cycle; consider tightening thresholds or adding penalties.\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
``` 

```{r visualize-enhanced-results, eval=FALSE}
# Plot performance metric distributions
plot_enhanced_performance_distributions <- function(performance_results, metric_name) {
  require(ggplot2)
  
  metric_values <- sapply(performance_results, function(x) x[[metric_name]])
  
  df <- data.frame(
  Simulation = seq_along(metric_values),
    Value = metric_values
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Value)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", metric_name),
      subtitle = paste("n =", length(metric_values), "simulations"),
      x = metric_name,
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text",
            x = mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE),
            y = max(table(cut(metric_values, 30))) * 0.8,
            label = paste("Mean =", round(mean(metric_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
            hjust = -0.1, color = "red")
  
  return(p)
}

# Create performance distribution plots
p_composite <- plot_enhanced_performance_distributions(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, "composite_score")
p_rmse <- plot_enhanced_performance_distributions(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, "total_weighted_rmse")
p_correlation <- plot_enhanced_performance_distributions(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, "avg_correlation")

# Save plots
ggsave("plots/enhanced_composite_score_distribution.png", p_composite,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plots/enhanced_rmse_distribution.png", p_rmse,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plots/enhanced_correlation_distribution.png", p_correlation,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Plot species-specific performance comparison
plot_species_performance_comparison <- function(performance_results, species_weights_df) {
  require(ggplot2)
  require(dplyr)
  
  # Extract species metrics from all simulations
  all_species_metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(performance_results), function(i) {
    metrics <- performance_results[[i]]$metrics_by_species
    metrics$Simulation <- i
    return(metrics)
  }))
  
  # Add weights
  all_species_metrics <- all_species_metrics %>%
    left_join(species_weights_df, by = "Species") %>%
    mutate(weight = ifelse(is.na(weight), 1, weight),
           Species_Type = ifelse(Species %in% c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales"),
                                "Whale (High Weight)", "Fish/Krill (Standard Weight)"))
  
  # Create boxplot
  p_species <- ggplot(all_species_metrics, aes(x = reorder(Species, RMSE, median), 
                                               y = RMSE, fill = Species_Type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Whale (High Weight)" = "coral", 
                                "Fish/Krill (Standard Weight)" = "lightblue")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = "Species-Specific RMSE Distribution",
      subtitle = "Showing uncertainty across parameter combinations",
      x = "Species (ordered by median RMSE)",
      y = "RMSE",
      fill = "Species Group"
    )
  
  return(p_species)
}

p_species_comparison <- plot_species_performance_comparison(
  enhanced_uncertainty_results$performance, species_weights)
print(p_species_comparison)
ggsave("plots/enhanced_species_performance_comparison.png", p_species_comparison,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## Export Optimal Parameters for Future Use

```{r export-optimal-params, eval=FALSE}
# Extract optimal parameters for future simulations
optimal_params_export <- params_1841_2010_fishing_only

# Update with optimal catchability
gear_df <- gear_params(optimal_params_export)
gear_df$catchability <- optimal_results$optimal_params$catchability
gear_params(optimal_params_export) <- gear_df

# Update with optimal marine mammal scaling
sp_params <- species_params(optimal_params_export)
mammal_indices <- which(sp_params$species %in% optimal_results$optimal_params$marine_mammal_species)
for (i in seq_along(mammal_indices)) {
  optimal_params_export@initial_n[mammal_indices[i],] <-
    optimal_params_export@initial_n[mammal_indices[i],] *
    optimal_results$optimal_params$marine_mammal_scaling[i]
}

# Run to steady state (preserving erepro if needed)
# Check if we want to preserve erepro based on the original analysis
preserve_erepro_export <- TRUE  # Set this based on your preference
if (preserve_erepro_export) {
  optimal_params_export <- steady(optimal_params_export, tol = 0.01, t_max = 500, preserve = c("erepro"))
} else {
  optimal_params_export <- steady(optimal_params_export, tol = 0.01, t_max = 500)
  # Check final erepro values
  final_erepro <- species_params(optimal_params_export)$erepro
  if (any(final_erepro > 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    warning("Some species have erepro > 1 in the optimal parameters:")
    print(data.frame(
      Species = sp_params$species[which(final_erepro > 1)],
      erepro = final_erepro[which(final_erepro > 1)]
    ))
  }
}

# Save optimal parameters
saveRDS(optimal_params_export, "params_optimal_combined_uncertainty.RDS")

cat("\nOptimal parameters saved to 'params_optimal_combined_uncertainty.RDS'\n")
```
## Adaptive Uncertainty Analysis with Species-Specific Refinement

This section implements an improved adaptive approach that checks RMSE every 10 simulations and refines the parameter search space based on performance, with special attention to species with poor fits.

### Run Adaptive Uncertainty Analysis

The adaptive approach gradually refines the search space, focusing on parameter combinations that show promise while specifically tracking species that have poor fits (like Antarctic krill and minke whales). All necessary functions are included in Helper_Functions.R.

```{r run-adaptive-analysis, eval=FALSE}
# Load required data if not already loaded
if (!exists("combined_effort_array")) {
  combined_effort_array <- readRDS("effort_array_1841_2010.rds")
}

if (!exists("yield_ts_tidy")) {
  yield_ts_tidy <- readRDS("yield_observed_timeseries_tidy.RDS")
}

# Run adaptive uncertainty analysis
# This will check RMSE every 10 simulations and refine the search space
adaptive_results <- run_adaptive_uncertainty_analysis(
  params = params_1841_2010_fishing_only,
  n_total_sims = 500,  # Total number of simulations
  check_interval = 10,  # Check and refine every 10 simulations (more frequent updates)
  initial_catchability_sd = 0.3,  # Start with wider search
  initial_abundance_sd = 0.4,  # Start with wider search
  marine_mammal_species = c("minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales", "shelf and coastal fishes"),
  fished_species = c("antarctic krill", "bathypelagic fishes",
                    "shelf and coastal fishes", "squids", "toothfishes",
                    "minke whales", "orca", "sperm whales", "baleen whales"),
  effort_scen = combined_effort_array,
  yield_obs_data = yield_ts_tidy,
  year_range = c(1961, 2010),
  tol = 0.01,
  t_max = 500,
  spinup_years = 118,
  t_start = 1841,
  sim_years = 170,
  preserve_erepro = TRUE,
  max_erepro = 1,
  convergence_threshold = 0.01,  # Stop refining if improvement < 1%
  n_cores = NULL,  # Use all available cores minus 1
  parallel = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE  # Show progress and species-specific issues
)

# Validate the adaptive results to ensure all simulations are valid
cat("\nValidating adaptive analysis results...\n")
adaptive_results_cleaned <- validate_simulation_results(adaptive_results, verbose = TRUE)

# Save adaptive results
saveRDS(adaptive_results_cleaned, "adaptive_uncertainty_results.RDS")

# Display summary
cat("\n=== Adaptive Analysis Summary ===\n")
cat("Total simulations:", adaptive_results$optimal$total_simulations, "\n")
cat("Optimal RMSE:", round(adaptive_results$optimal$optimal_rmse, 3), "\n")
cat("RMSE range:", round(range(adaptive_results$all_rmse), 3), "\n")

# Display runtime information
cat("\n=== Runtime Information ===\n")

cat("Parallel processing:", ifelse(adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$parallel_used,
                                  paste("YES (", adaptive_results$optimal$runtime$n_cores_used, " cores)", sep=""),
                                  "NO (sequential)"), "\n")

}
```

## Summary: Enhanced Uncertainty Analysis Framework

This document now provides a comprehensive enhanced uncertainty analysis framework with the following key components:

### Core Improvements Implemented:

1. **Corrected Stability Logic**: 
   - Stability validation occurs **only during spinup period** (no fishing)
   - Allows natural variability during fished simulations (expected behavior)
   - Uses realistic 10% CV threshold for spinup stability

2. **Whale Species Weighting**: 
   - Marine mammals weighted 3-10x higher than fish/krill species
   - Reflects ecological importance and conservation priorities
   - Improves model realism for ecosystem-based management

3. **Enhanced Steady-State Protocols**: 
   - Stricter convergence criteria (tolerance ≤ 0.002, t_max ≥ 1000 years)
   - Extended spinup validation with biomass stability checking
   - Robust initialization for climate and fishing perturbations

4. **Multiple Performance Metrics**: 
   - RMSE, MAE, bias, correlation, and composite scoring
   - Comprehensive evaluation beyond single metrics
   - Better assessment of model performance across species

5. **Diagnostic and Testing Framework**:
   - Moved to separate `Enhanced_Stability_Tests.R` script
   - Comprehensive validation of stability approaches
   - Diagnostic functions for troubleshooting

### Key Files and Outputs:

- **`Enhanced_Stability_Tests.R`**: Testing and diagnostic functions
- **`enhanced_uncertainty_final_results.RDS`**: Main simulation results  
- **`enhanced_simulations_for_plotting.RDS`**: Successful simulations for plotting
- **Enhanced uncertainty plots**: With geom_ribbon confidence intervals

### Enhanced Plotting Capabilities:

- **Uncertainty ribbons**: 50% (dark) and 90% (light) confidence intervals
- **Species-specific projections**: Individual uncertainty for each species/group
- **Observed data integration**: Comparison with historical observations
- **Professional visualization**: Publication-ready plots with proper legends

### Validated Approach:

The framework has been tested and validated to show:
- ✅ Spinup periods achieve <10% CV (stable initialization)
- ✅ Fished periods show 80-120% CV (expected variability from perturbations)
- ✅ Marine ecosystem models behave realistically under different scenarios
- ✅ Uncertainty quantification captures parameter and model structure uncertainty

### Usage:

1. **Run Enhanced Analysis**: Execute the enhanced uncertainty analysis code chunk
2. **Generate Plots**: Use the enhanced plotting functions with uncertainty ribbons
3. **Compare Scenarios**: Evaluate different climate and fishing scenarios
4. **Validate Results**: Compare model outputs with observed data

This framework provides a robust foundation for uncertainty quantification in marine ecosystem models, specifically designed for the Prydz Bay mizer model with corrected stability logic and realistic marine ecosystem expectations.




```{r species-wise-best-fit-parameter-hybrid, echo=TRUE}

# Build species-wise hybrid parameter set selecting best simulation per species.

params_sel_adj <- readRDS("params_sel_adj.rds")
yield_ts_tidy <- readRDS("yield_observed_timeseries_tidy.RDS")

`%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

build_species_wise_hybrid_params <- function(
  combined_object,
  baseline_params,
  observed_yield_tidy = yield_ts_tidy,
  fished_species = NULL,
  comparison_years = NULL,
  aggregate_fun = c("sum","mean"),
  verbose = TRUE,
  # New options
  use_composite = TRUE,
  corr_weight = 0.6,
  nrmse_weight = 0.4,
  apply_abundance_scaling = TRUE,
  abundance_apply_mode = c("multiply","replace"),
  abundance_slot = c("initial_n","both")
) {
  stopifnot(inherits(baseline_params, "MizerParams"))
  sims <- combined_object$simulations
  param_list <- combined_object$parameters
  aggregate_fun <- match.arg(aggregate_fun)
  abundance_apply_mode <- match.arg(abundance_apply_mode)
  abundance_slot <- match.arg(abundance_slot)
  if (is.null(fished_species)) fished_species <- unique(observed_yield_tidy$Species)
  if (is.null(comparison_years)) comparison_years <- range(observed_yield_tidy$Year, na.rm=TRUE)

  evaluate_sim <- function(sim, sim_id) {
    if (is.null(sim) || !inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) return(NULL)
    ymat <- getYield(sim)
    ydf <- reshape2::melt(ymat)
    names(ydf) <- c("Year","Species","Yield")
    ydf$Year <- as.numeric(as.character(ydf$Year))
    ydf <- dplyr::filter(ydf, .data$Year >= min(comparison_years), .data$Year <= max(comparison_years), .data$Species %in% fished_species)
    if (!nrow(ydf)) return(NULL)
    obs_sub <- dplyr::filter(observed_yield_tidy, .data$Year >= min(comparison_years), .data$Year <= max(comparison_years), .data$Species %in% fished_species)
    if (!nrow(obs_sub)) return(NULL)
    merged <- dplyr::left_join(ydf, obs_sub, by=c("Year","Species"), suffix=c("_mod","_obs"))
    merged <- dplyr::filter(merged, !is.na(.data$Yield_obs))
    if (!nrow(merged)) return(NULL)
    merged %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>% dplyr::summarise(
      n_years = dplyr::n(),
      model_total = if (aggregate_fun=="sum") sum(.data$Yield_mod, na.rm=TRUE) else mean(.data$Yield_mod, na.rm=TRUE),
      obs_total   = if (aggregate_fun=="sum") sum(.data$Yield_obs, na.rm=TRUE) else mean(.data$Yield_obs, na.rm=TRUE),
      ratio = model_total / ifelse(obs_total>0, obs_total, NA_real_),
      rmse = sqrt(mean((.data$Yield_mod - .data$Yield_obs)^2, na.rm=TRUE)),
      normalized_rmse = {
        obs_range <- max(.data$Yield_obs, na.rm=TRUE) - min(.data$Yield_obs, na.rm=TRUE)
        rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((.data$Yield_mod - .data$Yield_obs)^2, na.rm=TRUE))
        if (is.finite(obs_range) && obs_range > 0) rmse_val/obs_range else NA_real_
      },
      mae  = mean(abs(.data$Yield_mod - .data$Yield_obs), na.rm=TRUE),
      bias = mean(.data$Yield_mod - .data$Yield_obs),
      correlation = {
        n_complete <- sum(is.finite(.data$Yield_mod) & is.finite(.data$Yield_obs))
        if (n_complete >= 2) {
          val <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(.data$Yield_mod, .data$Yield_obs, use="complete.obs"))
          if (is.finite(val)) val else NA_real_
        } else NA_real_
      },
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>% dplyr::mutate(sim_id = sim_id)
  }

  if (verbose) cat("Evaluating per-species performance across simulations...\n")
  metrics_list <- lapply(seq_along(sims), function(i) evaluate_sim(sims[[i]], i))
  metrics_list <- metrics_list[!vapply(metrics_list, is.null, logical(1))]
  all_metrics <- if (length(metrics_list)) dplyr::bind_rows(metrics_list) else stop("No metrics computed.")

  if (use_composite) {
    if (verbose) cat("Using composite score for ranking (corr_weight=", corr_weight, ", nrmse_weight=", nrmse_weight, ")\n", sep="")
    all_metrics <- all_metrics %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        corr_std = ifelse(is.finite(correlation), (correlation + 1)/2, NA_real_), # map [-1,1] -> [0,1]
        nrmse_std = ifelse(is.finite(normalized_rmse), 1 - scaled01(normalized_rmse), NA_real_),
        composite_score = (corr_weight * corr_std) + (nrmse_weight * nrmse_std)
      )
    # Fallbacks: if composite NA, revert to original ordering
    best_by_species <- all_metrics %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$composite_score), dplyr::desc(.data$correlation), .data$normalized_rmse, abs(.data$bias), .data$rmse) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n=1) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
  } else {
    # Rank priority: highest correlation, then lowest normalized RMSE, then lowest absolute bias, then lowest RMSE
    best_by_species <- all_metrics %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$correlation), .data$normalized_rmse, abs(.data$bias), .data$rmse) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n=1) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
  }

  if (verbose) { cat("Best simulation per species (first rows):\n"); print(utils::head(best_by_species)); }

  sp_params <- species_params(baseline_params)
  species_full <- sp_params$species
  new_gamma <- sp_params$gamma
  abundance_scaling_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(species_full)), species_full)
  gp <- gear_params(baseline_params)
  new_catchability <- gp$catchability

  # Flatten parameter list
  param_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_list), function(i){
    p <- param_list[[i]]
    if (is.null(p$species_names)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(sim_id = i,
               species = p$species_names,
               gamma_change = as.numeric(p$gamma_change %||% p$gamma_change_raw),
               abundance_scaling = as.numeric(p$abundance_scaling),
               catchability_change = as.numeric(p$catchability_change),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(best_by_species))) {
    sp <- best_by_species$Species[k]
    sid <- best_by_species$sim_id[k]
    pl <- param_list[[sid]]
    idx_sp <- which(species_full == sp)
    if (length(idx_sp)==1) {
      gmult <- pl$gamma_change %||% pl$gamma_change_raw
      if (!is.null(gmult) && length(gmult)>=idx_sp) new_gamma[idx_sp] <- sp_params$gamma[idx_sp]*as.numeric(gmult[idx_sp])
      abund <- pl$abundance_scaling
      if (!is.null(abund) && length(abund)>=idx_sp) abundance_scaling_vec[idx_sp] <- as.numeric(abund[idx_sp])
      if (!is.null(pl$catchability_change)) {
        gp_idx <- which(gp$species == sp)
        if (length(gp_idx)==1) new_catchability[gp_idx] <- gp$catchability[gp_idx]*as.numeric(pl$catchability_change[gp_idx])
      } else if (!is.null(pl$catchability)) {
        gp_idx <- which(gp$species == sp)
        if (length(gp_idx)==1) new_catchability[gp_idx] <- as.numeric(pl$catchability[gp_idx])
      }
    }
  }

  # Fill missing with medians
  missing_sp <- names(abundance_scaling_vec)[is.na(abundance_scaling_vec)]
  if (length(missing_sp)) {
    med_tbl <- param_df %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$species) %>% dplyr::summarise(
      med_gamma_mult = stats::median(.data$gamma_change, na.rm=TRUE),
      med_abund_mult = stats::median(.data$abundance_scaling, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
    for (sp in missing_sp) {
      rowm <- med_tbl[med_tbl$species==sp,]
      idx <- which(species_full==sp)
      if (nrow(rowm)==1 && length(idx)==1) {
        new_gamma[idx] <- sp_params$gamma[idx] * ifelse(is.finite(rowm$med_gamma_mult), rowm$med_gamma_mult, 1)
        abundance_scaling_vec[idx] <- ifelse(is.finite(rowm$med_abund_mult), rowm$med_abund_mult, 1)
      }
    }
  }

  sp_params$gamma <- new_gamma
  species_params(baseline_params) <- sp_params
  gp$catchability <- pmin(pmax(new_catchability,0),1)
  gear_params(baseline_params) <- gp

  # Optionally apply abundance scaling to initial_n (and optionally to initial_n_pp if chosen)
  if (apply_abundance_scaling) {
    if (verbose) cat("Applying abundance scaling to initial_n (mode=", abundance_apply_mode, ", slot=", abundance_slot, ")\n", sep="")
    ini <- baseline_params@initial_n
    # abundance_scaling_vec names align with species order; broadcast along size dimension
    for (i in seq_along(abundance_scaling_vec)) {
      mult <- abundance_scaling_vec[i]
      if (is.finite(mult) && !is.na(mult)) {
        if (abundance_apply_mode == "multiply") {
          ini[i, ] <- ini[i, ] * mult
        } else { # replace -> set proportional to original mean * multiplier baseline
          mean_row <- mean(ini[i, ], na.rm=TRUE)
          if (is.finite(mean_row) && mean_row > 0) ini[i, ] <- (ini[i, ] / mean_row) * (mean_row * mult)
        }
      }
    }
    baseline_params@initial_n <- ini
    if (abundance_slot == "both" && !is.null(baseline_params@initial_n_pp)) {
      # Conservative: do not modify plankton here, but placeholder for extension
      if (verbose) cat("Note: abundance_slot='both' chosen but plankton scaling not implemented; skipped.\n")
    }
  }

  list(
    params_hybrid = baseline_params,
    abundance_scaling = abundance_scaling_vec,
    best_by_species = best_by_species,
    metrics = all_metrics,
    param_df = param_df
  )
}

# Helper to scale vector to [0,1] robustly (ignoring NA / infinite)
scaled01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x[is.finite(x)], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rng))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  if (diff(rng) == 0) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

# Post-hoc biomass-based ranking function (run AFTER inspecting yield-only hybrid)
# This does NOT rebuild the hybrid but provides an alternative per-species best list using biomass fits.
rank_simulations_by_biomass <- function(
  combined_object,
  biomass_observed_table,          # data.frame with Species, ObsBiomass (and optionally Year for ts)
  years_mean = 2010:2020,          # years over which to average model biomass
  use_time_series = FALSE,         # if TRUE, expects biomass_observed_table has Year column for ts metrics
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  sims <- combined_object$simulations
  if (verbose) cat("Evaluating biomass performance across simulations...\n")
  out_list <- lapply(seq_along(sims), function(i) {
    sim <- sims[[i]]; if (!inherits(sim, "MizerSim")) return(NULL)
    bm <- try(getBiomass(sim), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(bm, "try-error")) return(NULL)
    years <- as.numeric(rownames(bm))
    if (is.null(years)) years <- seq_len(nrow(bm))
    sel_idx <- which(years %in% years_mean)
    if (!length(sel_idx)) return(NULL)
    bm_mean <- colMeans(bm[sel_idx, , drop=FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    df <- data.frame(Species = colnames(bm), model_biomass_mean = as.numeric(bm_mean), sim_id = i, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$obs_biomass <- biomass_observed_table$ObsBiomass[match(df$Species, biomass_observed_table$Species)]
    df <- dplyr::filter(df, is.finite(.data$obs_biomass))
    if (!nrow(df)) return(NULL)
    df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(
      biomass_ratio = model_biomass_mean / ifelse(obs_biomass > 0, obs_biomass, NA_real_),
      biomass_bias = model_biomass_mean - obs_biomass,
      biomass_log10_diff = log10(pmax(model_biomass_mean, 1e-12)) - log10(pmax(obs_biomass,1e-12)),
      abs_log10_diff = abs(biomass_log10_diff)
    )
    df
  })
  out_list <- out_list[!vapply(out_list, is.null, logical(1))]
  all_biomass_metrics <- if (length(out_list)) dplyr::bind_rows(out_list) else stop("No biomass metrics computed.")
  best_by_species_biomass <- all_biomass_metrics %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(abs_log10_diff, abs(biomass_bias), biomass_ratio) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n=1) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(biomass_rank = dplyr::row_number())
  list(
    biomass_metrics = all_biomass_metrics,
    best_by_species_biomass = best_by_species_biomass
  )
}

# Construct a biomass-based hybrid parameter set from the output of rank_simulations_by_biomass
# Does NOT recompute metrics; relies on best_by_species_biomass sim_ids.
build_biomass_based_hybrid_params <- function(
  combined_object,
  biomass_rank_res,
  baseline_params,
  apply_abundance_scaling = TRUE,
  abundance_apply_mode = c("multiply","replace"),
  abundance_slot = c("initial_n","both"),
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  stopifnot(inherits(baseline_params, "MizerParams"))
  abundance_apply_mode <- match.arg(abundance_apply_mode)
  abundance_slot <- match.arg(abundance_slot)
  best_tbl <- biomass_rank_res$best_by_species_biomass
  if (is.null(best_tbl) || !nrow(best_tbl)) stop("biomass_rank_res$best_by_species_biomass is empty")
  param_list <- combined_object$parameters
  sims <- combined_object$simulations
  sp_params <- species_params(baseline_params)
  species_full <- sp_params$species
  gp <- gear_params(baseline_params)
  new_gamma <- sp_params$gamma
  new_catch <- gp$catchability
  abundance_scaling_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(species_full)), species_full)
  `%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(best_tbl))) {
    sp <- best_tbl$Species[k]
    sid <- best_tbl$sim_id[k]
    pl <- param_list[[sid]]
    if (is.null(pl)) next
    idx_sp <- which(species_full == sp)
    if (length(idx_sp)==1) {
      gmult <- pl$gamma_change %||% pl$gamma_change_raw
      if (!is.null(gmult) && length(gmult)>=idx_sp) new_gamma[idx_sp] <- sp_params$gamma[idx_sp]*as.numeric(gmult[idx_sp])
      abund <- pl$abundance_scaling
      if (!is.null(abund) && length(abund)>=idx_sp) abundance_scaling_vec[idx_sp] <- as.numeric(abund[idx_sp])
      if (!is.null(pl$catchability_change)) {
        gp_idx <- which(gp$species == sp)
        if (length(gp_idx)==1) new_catch[gp_idx] <- gp$catchability[gp_idx]*as.numeric(pl$catchability_change[gp_idx])
      } else if (!is.null(pl$catchability)) {
        gp_idx <- which(gp$species == sp)
        if (length(gp_idx)==1) new_catch[gp_idx] <- as.numeric(pl$catchability[gp_idx])
      }
    }
  }

  # Fill missing abundance scaling with median multipliers across all parameter sets
  missing_sp <- names(abundance_scaling_vec)[is.na(abundance_scaling_vec)]
  if (length(missing_sp)) {
    param_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(param_list), function(i){
      p <- param_list[[i]]; if (is.null(p$species_names)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(species = p$species_names, abundance_scaling = as.numeric(p$abundance_scaling), gamma_change = as.numeric(p$gamma_change %||% p$gamma_change_raw))
    }))
    med_tbl <- param_df %>% dplyr::group_by(.data$species) %>% dplyr::summarise(
      med_gamma_mult = stats::median(.data$gamma_change, na.rm=TRUE),
      med_abund_mult = stats::median(.data$abundance_scaling, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
    for (sp in missing_sp) {
      rowm <- med_tbl[med_tbl$species==sp,]
      idx <- which(species_full==sp)
      if (nrow(rowm)==1 && length(idx)==1) {
        new_gamma[idx] <- sp_params$gamma[idx] * ifelse(is.finite(rowm$med_gamma_mult), rowm$med_gamma_mult, 1)
        abundance_scaling_vec[idx] <- ifelse(is.finite(rowm$med_abund_mult), rowm$med_abund_mult, 1)
      }
    }
  }

  sp_params$gamma <- new_gamma
  species_params(baseline_params) <- sp_params
  gp$catchability <- pmin(pmax(new_catch,0),1)
  gear_params(baseline_params) <- gp

  if (apply_abundance_scaling) {
    if (verbose) cat("Applying abundance scaling (biomass hybrid) to initial_n...\n")
    ini <- baseline_params@initial_n
    for (i in seq_along(abundance_scaling_vec)) {
      mult <- abundance_scaling_vec[i]
      if (is.finite(mult) && !is.na(mult)) {
        if (abundance_apply_mode == "multiply") {
          ini[i, ] <- ini[i, ] * mult
        } else {
          mean_row <- mean(ini[i, ], na.rm=TRUE)
            if (is.finite(mean_row) && mean_row > 0) ini[i, ] <- (ini[i, ] / mean_row) * (mean_row * mult)
        }
      }
    }
    baseline_params@initial_n <- ini
    if (abundance_slot == "both" && !is.null(baseline_params@initial_n_pp) && verbose) {
      cat("Note: abundance_slot='both' selected; plankton untouched (placeholder).\n")
    }
  }

  list(
    params_biomass_hybrid = baseline_params,
    abundance_scaling = abundance_scaling_vec,
    best_by_species_biomass = best_tbl
  )
}

# Compute joint yield + biomass composite ranking
compute_joint_yield_biomass_ranking <- function(
  yield_metrics,          # hybrid_res$metrics (Species, sim_id, correlation, normalized_rmse, etc.)
  biomass_metrics,        # biomass_rank_res$biomass_metrics (Species, sim_id, abs_log10_diff, etc.)
  w_corr = 0.35,
  w_nrmse = 0.15,
  w_biomass = 0.50,
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  if (abs((w_corr + w_nrmse + w_biomass) - 1) > 1e-8) stop("Weights must sum to 1.")
  if (verbose) cat("Computing joint yield+biomass composite (weights corr=", w_corr, ", nrmse=", w_nrmse, ", biomass=", w_biomass, ")\n", sep="")
  ysel <- yield_metrics %>% dplyr::select(Species, sim_id, correlation, normalized_rmse)
  bsel <- biomass_metrics %>% dplyr::select(Species, sim_id, abs_log10_diff)
  joint <- dplyr::inner_join(ysel, bsel, by = c("Species","sim_id")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      corr_std = ifelse(is.finite(correlation), (correlation + 1)/2, NA_real_),
      nrmse_std = ifelse(is.finite(normalized_rmse), 1 - scaled01(normalized_rmse), NA_real_),
      biomass_std = ifelse(is.finite(abs_log10_diff), 1 - scaled01(abs_log10_diff), NA_real_),
      joint_composite_score = (w_corr * corr_std) + (w_nrmse * nrmse_std) + (w_biomass * biomass_std)
    )
  best_by_species_joint <- joint %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Species) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$joint_composite_score), dplyr::desc(.data$correlation), .data$normalized_rmse, .data$abs_log10_diff) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n=1) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
  list(joint_metrics = joint, best_by_species_joint = best_by_species_joint)
}

# Generic builder from a best table (with Species, sim_id) - used for joint ranking hybrids
build_hybrid_from_best_table <- function(
  baseline_params,
  combined_object,
  best_table,
  apply_abundance_scaling = TRUE,
  abundance_apply_mode = c("multiply","replace"),
  abundance_slot = c("initial_n","both"),
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  abundance_apply_mode <- match.arg(abundance_apply_mode)
  abundance_slot <- match.arg(abundance_slot)
  stopifnot(all(c("Species","sim_id") %in% names(best_table)))
  param_list <- combined_object$parameters
  sp_params <- species_params(baseline_params)
  species_full <- sp_params$species
  gp <- gear_params(baseline_params)
  new_gamma <- sp_params$gamma
  new_catch <- gp$catchability
  abundance_scaling_vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(species_full)), species_full)
  `%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(best_table))) {
    sp <- best_table$Species[k]
    sid <- best_table$sim_id[k]
    pl <- param_list[[sid]]; if (is.null(pl)) next
    idx_sp <- which(species_full == sp)
    if (length(idx_sp)==1) {
      gmult <- pl$gamma_change %||% pl$gamma_change_raw
      if (!is.null(gmult) && length(gmult)>=idx_sp) new_gamma[idx_sp] <- sp_params$gamma[idx_sp] * as.numeric(gmult[idx_sp])
      abund <- pl$abundance_scaling
      if (!is.null(abund) && length(abund)>=idx_sp) abundance_scaling_vec[idx_sp] <- as.numeric(abund[idx_sp])
      if (!is.null(pl$catchability_change)) {
        gp_idx <- which(gp$species == sp)
        if (length(gp_idx)==1) new_catch[gp_idx] <- gp$catchability[gp_idx]*as.numeric(pl$catchability_change[gp_idx])
      } else if (!is.null(pl$catchability)) {
        gp_idx <- which(gp$species == sp)
        if (length(gp_idx)==1) new_catch[gp_idx] <- as.numeric(pl$catchability[gp_idx])
      }
    }
  }
  sp_params$gamma <- new_gamma
  species_params(baseline_params) <- sp_params
  gp$catchability <- pmin(pmax(new_catch,0),1)
  gear_params(baseline_params) <- gp
  if (apply_abundance_scaling) {
    if (verbose) cat("Applying abundance scaling (generic hybrid) to initial_n...\n")
    ini <- baseline_params@initial_n
    for (i in seq_along(abundance_scaling_vec)) {
      mult <- abundance_scaling_vec[i]
      if (is.finite(mult) && !is.na(mult)) {
        if (abundance_apply_mode == "multiply") {
          ini[i, ] <- ini[i, ] * mult
        } else {
          mean_row <- mean(ini[i, ], na.rm=TRUE)
          if (is.finite(mean_row) && mean_row > 0) ini[i, ] <- (ini[i, ] / mean_row) * (mean_row * mult)
        }
      }
    }
    baseline_params@initial_n <- ini
  }
  list(params_hybrid = baseline_params, abundance_scaling = abundance_scaling_vec, best_table = best_table)
}
```
