<!-- Methodology: Post-hoc Biomass-Based Ranking -->
The yield-driven hybrid parameter set above optimizes per-species fits using correlation and normalized RMSE of modeled vs observed yields. After inspecting those yield-focused results, we optionally perform a separate biomass-based diagnostic ranking without altering the already-created hybrid parameters. This post-hoc step:

1. Extracts mean modeled biomass for each species over a target evaluation window (default 2010–2020).
2. Joins to observed biomass (and ignores species lacking observations).
3. Computes comparison metrics: absolute and signed biomass bias, biomass ratio (model / observed), and log10 difference (for scale robustness).
4. Ranks simulations per species by (a) minimal absolute log10 biomass difference, then (b) absolute bias, then (c) proximity of the ratio to 1.
5. Returns a per-species table of the simulation that best matches biomass magnitude, plus the full metric set for deeper inspection.

This biomass ranking is intentionally decoupled from the yield-based hybrid construction to (i) avoid overfitting multiple objectives simultaneously on a single pass, and (ii) let us compare whether the yield-selected hybrid also performs acceptably for biomass. If desired, a future iterative refinement could merge yield and biomass objectives into a unified multi-criteria composite.

```{r biomass-based-ranking-example, echo=TRUE}

)

  baseline_params = params_sel_adj,

  best_table = joint_rank$best_by_species_joint,

)
saveRDS(joint_hybrid, file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results","joint_hybrid_params.rds"))
cat("Saved joint yield+biomass hybrid params.\n")
```

```{r compare-hybrid-param-sets, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Compare three parameter sets: yield-hybrid, biomass-hybrid, joint-hybrid
# Workflow: load params -> steady() -> spin-up (unfished) -> full projection (with effort) -> plots

library(mizer)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

yield_ts_tidy <- readRDS("yield_observed_timeseries_tidy.RDS")

# Helper: safe loader extracting params if wrapped in list
load_params_object <- function(path, extract_candidates = c("params_hybrid","params_biomass_hybrid","params")) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    warning("File not found: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  obj <- readRDS(path)
  if (inherits(obj, "MizerParams")) return(obj)
  for (nm in extract_candidates) {
    if (!is.null(obj[[nm]]) && inherits(obj[[nm]], "MizerParams")) return(obj[[nm]])
  }
  warning("No MizerParams object found in ", path)
  NULL
}

# Paths
hybrid_path <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results","hybrid_params_applied.rds")
bio_only_path <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results","biomass_hybrid_params_only.rds")
joint_only_path <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results","joint_hybrid_params_only.rds")

# Fallback to list versions if *_only files not yet created
if (!file.exists(bio_only_path)) {
  alt <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results","biomass_hybrid_params.rds")
  bio_only_path <- alt
}
if (!file.exists(joint_only_path)) {
  alt <- file.path("Output_large_files","monte_carlo_results","combined_simulation_results","joint_hybrid_params.rds")
  joint_only_path <- alt
}

params_yield   <- load_params_object(hybrid_path)
params_biomass <- load_params_object(bio_only_path, extract_candidates = c("params_biomass_hybrid","params_hybrid","params"))
params_joint   <- load_params_object(joint_only_path, extract_candidates = c("params_hybrid","params"))

param_set_list <- list(
  YieldHybrid  = params_yield,
  BiomassHybrid = params_biomass,
  JointHybrid  = params_joint
)

param_set_list <- param_set_list[!vapply(param_set_list, is.null, logical(1))]
if (!length(param_set_list)) stop("No parameter sets loaded successfully.")

# Effort time series (fallbacks)
effort_ts <- NULL
if (file.exists("effort_array_1841_2010.rds")) {
  effort_ts <- readRDS("effort_array_1841_2010.rds")
} else if (file.exists("effort_array.csv")) {
  effort_ts <- try(read.csv("effort_array.csv", row.names = 1), silent = TRUE)
}

# Determine projection length
spinup_years <- 118              # Length (years) of one spin-up cycle (unfished)
spinup_reps  <- 3                # Number of times to repeat spin-up cycle (set >1 to lengthen spin-up)
t_start <- 1841
full_years <- if (!is.null(effort_ts)) nrow(effort_ts) else 170  # fallback length

# Normalize effort object shape for project()
prepare_effort <- function(effort_mat, params) {
  if (is.null(effort_mat)) return(0) # constant zero effort
  # Ensure colnames match gear names
  gears <- gear_params(params)$gear
  if (!all(gears %in% colnames(effort_mat))) {
    # Add missing gear columns as zeros
    missing <- setdiff(gears, colnames(effort_mat))
    for (m in missing) effort_mat[[m]] <- 0
  }
  effort_mat <- effort_mat[, gears, drop = FALSE]
  effort_mat
}

run_full_pipeline <- function(params, label, spinup_years, spinup_reps = 1) {
  if (is.null(params)) return(NULL)
  cat("\n--- Running pipeline for", label, "---\n")
  spinup_reps <- max(1, as.integer(spinup_reps))
  total_spin_years <- spinup_years * spinup_reps
  if (spinup_reps > 1) {
    cat("Spin-up cycles:", spinup_reps, "(total spin-up years =", total_spin_years, ")\n")
  } else {
    cat("Spin-up years:", total_spin_years, "\n")
  }
  # Steady
  params_ss <- try(steady(params, tmax = 4000, tol = 0.002, progress_bar = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(params_ss, "try-error")) { params_ss <- params; warning("steady() failed for ", label) }
  # Spin-up (unfished)
  sim_spin <- try(project(params_ss, t_start = t_start, t_max = total_spin_years, effort = 0), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(sim_spin, "try-error")) { warning("Spin-up failed for ", label); sim_spin <- NULL }
  # Full projection with effort (or zero)
  eff_obj <- prepare_effort(effort_ts, params_ss)
  sim_full <- try(project(params_ss, t_start = t_start, t_max = full_years, effort = eff_obj), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(sim_full, "try-error")) { warning("Full projection failed for ", label); sim_full <- NULL }
  list(label = label, params = params_ss, sim_spin = sim_spin, sim_full = sim_full)
}

results_list <- lapply(names(param_set_list), function(nm) run_full_pipeline(param_set_list[[nm]], nm, spinup_years = spinup_years, spinup_reps = spinup_reps))
names(results_list) <- names(param_set_list)

# Build biomass comparison df
build_biomass_df <- function(res_list) {
  dfs <- lapply(res_list, function(x){
    if (is.null(x$sim_full)) return(NULL)
    bm <- getBiomass(x$sim_full)
    df <- reshape2::melt(bm)
    names(df) <- c("Year","Species","Biomass")
    df$ParamSet <- x$label
    df
  })
  dfs <- dfs[!vapply(dfs, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (!length(dfs)) return(NULL)
  dplyr::bind_rows(dfs)
}

biomass_cmp <- build_biomass_df(results_list)

plot_biomass_comparison <- function(df,
                                     obs_df = NULL,
                                     obs_bounds = NULL,
                                     obs_years = 2010:2020,
                                     species_subset = NULL,
                                     show_legend = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  if (!is.null(species_subset)) df <- dplyr::filter(df, Species %in% species_subset)

  # Observed bounds handling (mimic baseline logic)
  if (!is.null(obs_df)) {
    if (is.null(obs_bounds) && exists("obs_biomass_bounds")) {
      obs_bounds <- obs_biomass_bounds
    }
    if (!is.null(obs_bounds)) {
      obs_bounds_use <- obs_bounds %>%
        dplyr::select(Species, Lower = dplyr::matches("Lower"), Upper = dplyr::matches("Upper"))
    } else {
      obs_bounds_use <- obs_df %>%
        dplyr::transmute(Species, Lower = ObsBiomass * 0.75, Upper = ObsBiomass * 1.25)
    }
    obs_ts <- obs_df %>%
      dplyr::left_join(obs_bounds_use, by = "Species") %>%
      tidyr::crossing(Year = obs_years)
  } else {
    obs_ts <- NULL
  }

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(Year)), y = Biomass, colour = ParamSet)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    labs(title = "Biomass Comparison Across Parameter Sets",
         x = "Year",
         y = "Biomass [g]") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none")

  if (!is.null(obs_ts)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_ribbon(data = obs_ts,
                  aes(x = Year, ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.18, fill = "grey70", colour = NA) +
      geom_point(data = obs_ts,
                 aes(x = Year, y = ObsBiomass),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.6, colour = "black")
  }
  p
}

plot_biomass_comparison(biomass_cmp, obs_biomass_data)
```

# Analysis Complete

This restructured analysis provides:

1. **Core Functions Integration**: All critical uncertainty analysis functions moved from Helper_Functions.R
2. **Parameter Distribution Assessment**: Comprehensive plotting and statistics for Monte Carlo parameters  
3. **Biomass Rejection Criteria**: Strict filtering based on 2000-2010 modeled vs 2010-2020 observed biomass (±25% tolerance)
4. **Post-Rejection Analysis**: Comparison of parameter distributions and model performance after filtering
5. **Uncertainty Quantification**: Full uncertainty bounds for accepted simulations
